subject: My life and my future are in your hands
body:
| | | Dear Peter, I am writing to you to encourage your support of the Thomas More Society defense efforts for me and my family. Since my arrest on September 23rd, and even prior to that, the Thomas More Society team has been such a gift to us. From Matt Heffron, who handled my grand jury investigation, to Peter Breen, Thomas More Society attorneys have been a pure blessing in this legal battle. What confidence it brings to me and my wife, knowing that my life and future lie in the hands of these talented and capable God-fearing men. [**Please prayerfully consider a donation enabling the Thomas More Society to not only represent me, but enable them to do so for you and others when and if the time is needed.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694687:6hZ-GRVTN:m:1:3253819041:767A48C6388182129F6FF4DBE6D73853:r) ** ** Founder Tom Brejcha could not have been more gracious and generous to me as he assured me that the Thomas More Society would handle all of my legal fees. Also, the Thomas More Society secured for my defense the best lawyer in the city of Philadelphia, Brian McMonagle. Together, Peter and Brian are fighting to secure my rights as a citizen, pro-lifer and father and ultimately yours too. What a privilege it is to be called to this battle. I know the Lord has a mighty plan for my life and this current cross that I bear. God's grace is truly sufficient and I believe that what man intended for evil, God intends for good (Genesis 50:20). That said, God uses His people to answer prayers. **Will you be an answer to prayer?** ** ** [**Will you help TMS and their defense efforts of me by supporting the legal fund with your best gift today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694687:6hZ-GRVTN:m:1:3253819041:767A48C6388182129F6FF4DBE6D73853:r) ** ** The Thomas More Society stepped out in faith by stating they will represent me and my battle against the tyranny of government. I give thanks to God each day for Thomas More Society and their presence to me at this time. Please join me in supporting them financially and prayerfully. Rest assured of my prayers for you as you partner with me, my family and this phenomenal legal team. Your brother in the battle,

**Heads up Pennsylvanians: October 24 is the last day to register to vote in the upcoming election this November.**
**To register to vote in Pennsylvania you must:**
* Be a citizen of the United States at least one month before Election Day
* Be a resident of Pennsylvania and your election district at least 30 days before Election Day
* Be at least 18 years of age on the day of Election Day
* Not have been in prison within the last five years for a felony conviction

You can also **register to vote in Pennsylvania in three different ways — online, by mail or in person.** If you register by mail your registration must be postmarked by October 24.
Election Day is coming and the time to elect officials who can and will represent us in office is now.

clean_body: Let’s get you registered! | | | Pennsylvania’s deadline to register to vote is coming up! | | | Friend, Heads up Pennsylvanians: October 24 is the last day to register to vote in the upcoming election this November. To register to vote in Pennsylvania you must: Be a citizen of the United States at least one month before Election Day Be a resident of Pennsylvania and your election district at least 30 days before Election Day Be at least 18 years of age on the day of Election Day Not have been in prison within the last five years for a felony conviction You can also register to vote in Pennsylvania in three different ways — online, by mail or in person. If you register by mail your registration must be postmarked by October 24. Election Day is coming and the time to elect officials who can and will represent us in office is now. Over the past few elections, younger Americans have turned out in record numbers, helping Democrats win elections across the country. As a result, many states made real progress, taxing the ultra-rich, legalizing marijuana, protecting voting rights, and fighting climate change. That’s the power we have when we register to vote and make our voices heard in local, state, and federal elections. This is an empowering first step to securing a safer, healthier democracy for our generation and generations to come. We have the choice to fight back and make way for real progress for our friends, families, and neighbors, so let’s get started. "CTA Button" Solidarity, NextGen Pennsylvania P.S. Peter,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694841:6PJNIRVN9:m:1:3331421248:09DCF5BF8C93FAB9C435D85E9DAB8CB0:r)

---

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. **New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district is named one of the “Key Races [that] Will Decide Control of Congress.”**
Republicans only need to flip five seats red this November to take majority control of the House, and if they succeed, they’ve already made it clear they will use that power to pass a nationwide abortion ban, raise taxes on working families and seniors, and cut Social Security and Medicare.
Our race is key to defending the House and stopping this extreme agenda from passing. As _Newsweek_ explained:
_“GOP Representative Yvette Herrell in New Mexico's Second Congressional District narrowly won in 2020, despite Trump easily carrying the district. I'm writing today to invite you to join other conservatives who are pressuring lawmakers to end Biden's open border extremism by completing a simple 1-minute survey using the link below:

**[https://secured.heritage.org/immigration-reform-survey/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9b7df2a3bf664cf9a086608e7a1cca81&_e=I4fxNmjPePLHgNvypR4zXVONbaG1ByIqoLVSxyhR0SbvYQDQKih9ms4VsTwYLeIhVOmZVG8oU-pSD6QVUuxMjudNZcxUngYHIn2IxXWq66bsPwTY9vn9g9vlJmhjr9WGYRLO5fCAcJo5DjaZhGKKBLbMIShzRxKoydprBvNgwoCRXOBU-Tjd-V8_7zuQ3Ry-mPIkR85nlmIBifqge4SJeTD0Gm5S45LuKWZKj2so2QFFHsysZh3vB-d6htLhQ9xjkuWYV7MJIevRd8yzrI62VdKTImgYttwhHEYVxkIR_hIzkKPBYO3ykQzwZRmcABHHvCEgPXZ_z0mZxyHIWa-Nj076HWFC7Y-1OILkiSC-pDEqfFaBYCN7zXOQ-6a8XZdA)**

This is more encounters than ever before in our nation's history--_more than double that of any year during President Donald Trump 's term._

So when people ask me what I think of Biden's immigration policy, I reply: _what immigration policy?_

Beginning the day he took office, Biden's "policies" have created one of the worst humanitarian crises our nation has ever seen.

And now, untold scores of narcotics, violent criminals, and human traffickers are being allowed to flood into American communities, practically unabated, _every single day._

Decades of success advancing conservative policies have taught us that lawmakers in Washington tend to be more responsive when they know that voters are paying attention.

**Armed with your response, we will work on your behalf to turn up the pressure on lawmakers and compel them to act now.**

**[https://secured.heritage.org/immigration-reform-survey/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9b7df2a3bf664cf9a086608e7a1cca81&_e=I4fxNmjPePLHgNvypR4zXVONbaG1ByIqoLVSxyhR0SbvYQDQKih9ms4VsTwYLeIhVOmZVG8oU-pSD6QVUuxMjudNZcxUngYHIn2IxXWq66bsPwTY9vn9g9vlJmhjr9WGYRLO5fCAcJo5DjaZhGKKBLbMIShzRxKoydprBvNgwoCRXOBU-Tjd-V8_7zuQ3Ry-mPIkR85nlmIBifqge4SJeeMprwdIvM6KYwIlOnkM5nV4HxsybxNU2UosLUBH95nYvbrzi9z26dUc1lV8ft7cvZzYWE0MC25Lu2MAeNyuzWb0vIziIy3SMPhPGtSqz6tUHnTrGpClgBF8fJs-_3dfEGAlYQ6YyVEYzzYeOySchqZsHZXL47G9eKEBq4FKx492)**

Friend – **my roots are planted deeply in Georgia soil.**

I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah – and I attended Morehouse College, a historically Black university in Atlanta. I went on what I called a "full faith" scholarship, meaning I didn't know how I would pay for my first full semester.
But through hard work and the support of my community, I was the first in my family to graduate from college – and then became the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church, the spiritual home of Martin Luther King Jr.

I know firsthand how attending an HBCU prepared me for a life of service – and I'm fighting tooth and nail in the Senate to make sure every kid has the opportunity to achieve their American dream.
**But this is going to be an uphill battle: Experts at _NPR_ confirm that I'm the _most vulnerable_ Senate Democrat up for reelection, and the polls show me neck and neck with my GOP opponent. name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 11 years in prison for standing up for life?!
body:
I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Fellow American, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort – which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zme4sef7djq1b8sp5dr0q3q32t7m9eqsi9g60t0o_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ge0p32c9h2bs) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in – by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zrb526l4m5arjnbvs8m6lv1acrnsf4n0pdnqrm48_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ge0p32c9h2bs) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society – the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. | | | | | Friend, We’re coming down to the final days and weeks of this year’s election season, and here at Indivisible, **[we’re using what little time we have left to hold (and hopefully expand) our Democratic majority in Congress.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T16051850-a373-49c5-bac8-02f5b890ea98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** This year’s midterms could come down to a handful of votes, literally. Remember when President Biden won Georgia and Arizona by about 1/4 of 1 percent in 2020? **These are the types of races we’re looking at now, folks — races where even a tiny investment could make the difference.** We’re in this fight together — and together is how we’re going to win. This broad, pro-democracy supermajority is pulling together to defeat the radical MAGA zealots seeking to roll back our access to abortion, attack our most vulnerable communities, and tear down our democracy. And if we all do our part, we’re going to win this thing. **[That’s why we’re reaching out, to ask if you’ll join the fight with us. Add your name if you agree it’s important we do absolutely everything we can right now to protect our Democratic majority and prevent MAGA Republicans from taking over our democracy.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T61902130-0d0f-4c5d-ae94-605189f80551/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| | | Here’s how high the stakes are this November, friends: _FiveThirtyEight_ says that 60 percent of Americans will have an election denier on the ballot. 60 percent! These candidates are legitimate threats to our democracy, but we know how to stop them. Indivisible groups across the country are putting in the work to highlight MAGA Republicans’ extremism and shift the narrative of this election. Recent polls show our strategy is working – but as races are tightening across the country, we simply cannot take any chances. With just days until November 8, we’re looking to pour every resource we can into this fight. If — no, when — we win, we get a real and functioning democracy, and we make Mitch McConnell, Joe Manchin, and Kyrsten Sinema politically irrelevant. But we won’t have the votes tomorrow unless we do the work today. Our democracy’s on the ballot this November, and it’s on us to protect it. [**If you’re with us, add your name right away.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4485468a-628f-4e20-8bed-208acdd393f9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for being a part of this movement. In solidarity, Indivisible Team

| Peter,
I recently joined Tucker Carlson and the buzz around my campaign has continued to gain tremendous momentum. I'm taking time from my busy schedule campaigning to write you this email, so even if you don't send a gift, I'd really appreciate it if you'd read it in its entirety.
**[If you'd like to make a donation to continue my campaign's momentum, you can do so here.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694968:68ilwRVYN:m:1:3317145305:A53809AD94FBD3B32F09F30D36F6176B:r)**
We covered a number of topics that I think every voter in PA should know about.
**The Establishment turning their back on a 30 year Army veteran.** I served our country honorably and led some of the best young men our nation has to offer, yet when I announced for Governor the political Establishment on both sides shunned me... it must mean I'm speaking the hard truths, but as our second President John Adams famously said "facts are stubborn things." The political Establishment in our country is failing Republicans, Democrats, and everyone in between, and I'll never bow to their go-along get-along agenda. They doubted me in the primary, but with the backing of the grassroots and patriots in Pennsylvania and across our country, I proved them wrong, and I'm going to do it again on November 8th.
**Unleashing Pennsylvania 's oil and gas reserves to jumpstart our economy on Day 1 of a Mastriano administration.** The answer to many of our economic woes is unleashing American energy dominance, and as Governor of Pennsylvania, on Day 1, I'll have the power to open up drilling and fracking at a scale never seen before in our nation's history. Joe Biden's war on American energy got us into this mess, and Pennsylvania will be where the American energy comeback begins. | | | | [DONATE](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694968:68ilwRVYN:m:1:3317145305:A53809AD94FBD3B32F09F30D36F6176B:r)
---
**Josh Shapiro 's record of failure when it comes to violent crime.**
Unlike Josh Shapiro, I've served in war zones, and right now Philadelphia looks more like a war zone than the city where American Democracy was born. Crime has gone up 40% since Shapiro took power as Attorney General. Videos have surfaced online showing bands of criminals with illegal automatic weapons hopping out of vans at gas stations in Philadelphia and stealing cars of innocent citizens. There's one place criminals like that will be under a Mastriano Administration, the state penitentiary, where they will be serving maximum sentences.

**There are 12 Pennsylvanian 's dying everyday from Fentynal.**
Biden's open border has drugs flowing into our country freely and it's causing a drug epidemic in Pennsylvania. Dealers and traffickers of these lethal drugs will be in the same place as the criminals sticking up drivers at gunpoint, the penitentiary.

At the end of our interview, Tucker came to the same conclusion that everyone who knows me can testify to, I'm not a radical, I'm just a guy who loves his country and his state too much to let it be destroyed by the woke left. I could have ridden off into the sunset for a comfortable retirement with the love of my life, my wife Rebbie, but instead I'm here, fighting for you and your family. **[I'd be proud to call you a donor to my campaign if you're in a position to give.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694968:68ilwRVYN:m:1:3317145305:A53809AD94FBD3B32F09F30D36F6176B:r)**

After 30 years in uniform serving our country, I know one thing, the fight to save our country is worth fighting. Nothing on earth has ever come close to the greatness of the promise of the American Dream, and I'm doing everything in my power to preserve it. I'd be honored if you joined me.
| | | [DONATE](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694968:68ilwRVYN:m:1:3317145305:A53809AD94FBD3B32F09F30D36F6176B:r)
---
In liberty,

Retired Colonel Doug Mastriano

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Are you feeling this way?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
I’m determined to make Pennsylvania safer, fairer, stronger, and more prosperous for all.

Hey there, Derek I’ve talked to a lot of voters during my campaign – making stops in counties from East to West to meet with Pennsylvanians who are facing real problems. Some of them told me that they have lost faith in our government. They take the time to vote but then the politicians they help elect never take the time to help. Maybe you’re feeling the same way. But I’m here to change that. I tell those Pennsylvanians that they should be optimistic, hopeful, and believe that the government can be a force for positive change. Because I’m going to do everything in my power — God-willing — as Pennsylvania’s next Governor to live up to that and to make sure that we do good for a lot of people. I’ll ensure that our government works for all no matter what you look like, where you come from, who you love, or who you pray to. Because that’s what I’ve always done. **This is a consequential race, Derek — from the future of our democracy to the rights we rely upon, the winner of the Governor’s race will shape Pennsylvania.** **[To live up to those ideals and actually deliver for Pennsylvanians, I need your help to win this election. With just 19 days left, can you donate any amount right now to support this campaign in the home stretch?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52967595/374018886/-586780698?refcode=email_102022_hope_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=77d50fa9-9750-ed11-819c-002248258e08&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2Q1MGZhOS05NzUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zkh584c_Udy-EbLt1zr4qgJtryEnbwtQL0h51-AgYAk=)** I’m determined to make Pennsylvania safer, fairer, stronger, and more prosperous for all. And you can trust me to actually take on the big fights, because I have a track record of doing just that. As Attorney General, I took on the powerful without fear or favor to do what’s right for Pennsylvanians. I defended the results of Pennsylvania’s 2020 presidential election, fought for reproductive rights, took millions of doses of illegal drugs off the streets, and exposed the Catholic Church’s decades-long cover-up of childhood sexual abuse. **I’ve delivered results for Pennsylvanians throughout my career — and you can trust me to do the same as your next Governor.** **[Have hope in this election, Derek — because together, we can make a difference for families all across the Commonwealth. To win this race for Pennsylvania’s future, can you donate today to support my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52967596/374018887/-586780698?refcode=email_102022_hope_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=77d50fa9-9750-ed11-819c-002248258e08&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2Q1MGZhOS05NzUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Zkh584c_Udy-EbLt1zr4qgJtryEnbwtQL0h51-AgYAk=)** Thank you for being on my side as we barrel towards Election Day. body:

---
| Contact: Andrew Boucher andrew@ascent-strategic.com, 970-219-2831
---
---
| Protect Freedom PAC Launches Comprehensive Campaigns in AZ, UT, and WI Senate Races
---
| Athens, GA - Protect Freedom PAC, a Rand Paul affiliated Super PAC dedicated to supporting pro-liberty and freedom-minded candidates, announced that they have launched independent expenditure campaigns in favor of Blake Masters in Arizona, Senator Mike Lee in Utah, and Senator Ron Johnson in Wisconsin. The independent expenditure campaigns are made up of a mix of digital advertising, direct mail, direct voter contact, and television.
---
| These independent expenditure campaigns are part of the nearly $8 million spent by Protect Freedom PAC this cycle.
Protect Freedom PAC endorses and supports candidates for statewide and federal offices and has made independent expenditures totaling approximately $20 million since 2018. The organization was founded by a team of veterans of the Donald Trump, Ron Paul, and Rand Paul campaigns for President.
---
| |
---
| Protect Freedom PAC was founded for the purpose of supporting pro-freedom and liberty-minded candidates using the tactics, technology, and strategy that best fits each race individually. PFP was founded by seasoned political veterans with decades of national campaign experience, which includes working on the campaigns of both Ron and Rand Paul.

**[Now is the time for conservatives across the nation to get off the sidelines and into this fight.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqv04ip9lecqss62cjg3rbghhj37n6q63qkki2d8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9geao34s9h2bs)**
**The clock is ticking, and the stakes are high.**
This race in Georgia is not just a fight for conservatives against woke socialism. Winning it would be a victory for personal redemption against gutter politics. For struggling families over cynical elites. And for America against the corrupt frauds tearing her down.
**[Help Herschel Walker. Help America. Give today!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zb3htahtel5e1i5ahvoctns2am5ao7oikdft1hbg_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9geao34s9h2bs)**

subject: Let me tell you about when I started working for Barack Obama
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ERIC LYNN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Eric Lynn for Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP24/1/93680/images/lynn-email-logo.png]
Hi team,

When I met Barack Obama it was a light-bulb moment for me. As we come up on the last few weeks before Election Day, I'm reminded of how this campaign first started.

Chip in here to save our Democratic majority in Congress → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/el-email?refcode2=d3445f9c-9b50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&refcode=221020_el_obamacampaign_l1]

Picture this: It was 2007, and a then little-known Senator named Barack Obama announced his candidacy for President of the United States. I was one of the first 40 people to join Obama's historic campaign, serving as one of the national security advisors.

secure.actblue.com/donate/el-email?refcode2=d3445f9c-9b50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&refcode=221020_el_obamacampaign_i1 [secure.actblue.com/donate/el-email?refcode2=d3445f9c-9b50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&refcode=221020_el_obamacampaign_i1]

I was inspired to join the campaign. I think most of all it was the hopeful energy that surrounded his message and his intelligence. He had a clear vision for our future, and a sharp, thoughtful, patriotic group of people who were supporting him along the way.

I jumped in with both feet, and I worked around the clock to do all that I could to help him win in 2008. Now, as the candidate myself, I think back on those early days, and I'm proud to say that we've continued that hopeful, engaging, and empathetic way of running for office on Team Lynn.

My campaign is full of people with experience in the community, expertise on the issues that matter most to our voters, and countless volunteers who connect with people across the district.

In 2008, one slogan was "Change we can believe in." I know this election season has felt a little different. There's been ugly rhetoric being flung from the far right corners of our political spectrum. We see the divisiveness that many of our most important issues can cause.

But another slogan was “Yes We Can,” and together, we can all believe in a future where we have affordable health care, a protected environment, access to quality education, and jobs that provide for our families.

I'm proud to have learned so much from President Obama, and now, I'm proud to continue my journey to represent my hometown, FL-13, in Congress.

Thank you for your support, team.

– Eric Lynn, Democratic Nominee for FL-13
Eric Lynn is a former Senior Advisor to President Obama, national security expert, small business owner, community advocate, and St. Petersburg Native who is ready to lead Pinellas County forward. Empathic, passionate, and pragmatic, Eric knows how to get the job done in Washington on day one.
Will you join Eric's team and support him for Congress?

body:
| | | |
---
| BREAKING NEWS:
---
---
| Geoff Diehl has been officially endorsed by former United States Senator and Ambassador to New Zealand Scott Brown.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fuqwOeBCzS0ZPy-B-ny-Qtlyo7dikRYxQdyjm9Xnm66gYgUe06281SShKCrLtHmuRVMWZnMuYlxkVdy1Lda82WiB5xbG96ajRBPNcSMh4We_wlPRI96il24s5z0CXsj9IaNUUSdtr9HTkleGcUKZEw==&c=5FPyNvdQZbAK3szdJQjXBPXrBIHHdYxyIV3EIdIvFt-ou3gQVZGzJg==&ch=PiVTsK5tkNeZlJsvuTdMBEaxuZskQH5dK0ZK5Si37JVWmwKdT-dxOQ==)
---
| [Watch on YouTube](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fuqwOeBCzS0ZPy-B-ny-Qtlyo7dikRYxQdyjm9Xnm66gYgUe06281SShKCrLtHmuRVMWZnMuYlxkVdy1Lda82WiB5xbG96ajRBPNcSMh4We_wlPRI96il24s5z0CXsj9IaNUUSdtr9HTkleGcUKZEw==&c=5FPyNvdQZbAK3szdJQjXBPXrBIHHdYxyIV3EIdIvFt-ou3gQVZGzJg==&ch=PiVTsK5tkNeZlJsvuTdMBEaxuZskQH5dK0ZK5Si37JVWmwKdT-dxOQ==)
---
---
| "I've known Geoff Diehl for 15 years. Geoff is a good man, and he's a hard worker. When he gives you his word, it's gold," Brown said in a video announcing his endorsement. "Geoff is the person you need right now on Beacon Hill to rein in the spending, rein in the out-of-control policies and laws that are being pushed by the Democrats up there. I mean, it's upside-down."
In the video, Brown reminds people of his legendary come-from-behind win for U.S. Senate in 2010, a victory that Diehl has referred to repeatedly in his own campaign. "Remember back in 2010, when I was down 41 points, then 21 points, then 11 points, and we ended up winning by 7? Not only did we shock the Democrats in Massachusetts, we really shocked the nation, and created a check and balance that was badly, badly needed."
In closing, Brown has a message for Massachusetts voters who want to see a victory on Election Day. "Do not wake up on November 9 and say, 'Gosh, I should have done more.' I'm asking you to get out, make a difference, and vote for Geoff Diehl for Governor."
Friends, this race is far, far from being over. We're going to win.

Geoff is a good man, and he's a hard worker. When he gives you his word, it's gold," Brown said in a video announcing his endorsement. "Geoff is the person you need right now on Beacon Hill to rein in the spending, rein in the out-of-control policies and laws that are being pushed by the Democrats up there. I mean, it's upside-down." In the video, Brown reminds people of his legendary come-from-behind win for U.S. Senate in 2010, a victory that Diehl has referred to repeatedly in his own campaign. "Remember back in 2010, when I was down 41 points, then 21 points, then 11 points, and we ended up winning by 7? Not only did we shock the Democrats in Massachusetts, we really shocked the nation, and created a check and balance that was badly, badly needed." In closing, Brown has a message for Massachusetts voters who want to see a victory on Election Day. "Do not wake up on November 9 and say, 'Gosh, I should have done more.' I'm asking you to get out, make a difference, and vote for Geoff Diehl for Governor." Friends, this race is far, far from being over. name: Herschel Walker
subject: Warnock supporters are calling me racial slurs
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
---

Peter,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694994:J5TovRVmN:m:1:3317145305:8DA9D1F7F2079E298C02E101BFDCE203:r)
While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments **(sometimes for as little as $28)** , a protester in the crowd said of me:

| _**" He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_
---

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight.

Peter, it's sad this is the type of environment we're running in, but it's a pattern from the Left we've seen numerous times throughout this campaign. With early voting already underway, **[we need to ensure Georgians that we're not fazed by the nasty attacks against us.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694994:J5TovRVmN:m:1:3317145305:8DA9D1F7F2079E298C02E101BFDCE203:r)**

**[Will you stand with me today to make it clear to the Left that we will not stand for this divisive, hateful language?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694994:J5TovRVmN:m:1:3317145305:8DA9D1F7F2079E298C02E101BFDCE203:r)**

[** Stand With Herschel -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694994:J5TovRVmN:m:1:3317145305:8DA9D1F7F2079E298C02E101BFDCE203:r)
Tuesday's protester viciously attacked me for the color of my skin because I'm willing to STAND UP for my conservative values and SPEAK OUT for the truth.

Georgia needs a new U.S. Senator, and **[I hope you'll support our campaign today to make it happen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694994:J5TovRVmN:m:1:3317145305:8DA9D1F7F2079E298C02E101BFDCE203:r)**

Thank you,

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61694994:J5TovRVmN:m:1:3317145305:8DA9D1F7F2079E298C02E101BFDCE203:r)

Herschel Walker

Folks —
Across Oregon, people are frustrated and struggling to make ends meet. With rising prices for gas, groceries, and prescription drugs, I know what those kitchen table conversations sound like.
I started my career at Oregon Food Bank, hearing directly from folks all over the state who were struggling, many working hard and still feeling left behind and in need of help.
As House Speaker, I worked hard for working families – increasing the minimum wage, capping insulin prices, and protecting renters from eviction. And as Governor, I will continue to keep fighting to make housing, child care, and health care more affordable.
My plans include:
* **Lowering prescription drug costs for Oregonians** by partnering with other states to help keep prices down.

* **Addressing our affordable housing shortage** by building more workforce housing across the state.

* **Improving access to child care** by cutting the red tape that limits where home-based child care providers can operate.

* **Holding companies accountable for stealing wages from workers** by increasing enforcement on bad employers and ensuring justice for victims of discrimination in the workplace.

* **Giving all Oregonians a fighting chance to develop new job skills** by providing more access to community college, job training, and apprenticeships while also expanding access to high-speed internet.

There’s a lot a Governor can do to help hard-working Oregonians make ends meet. I’ll work every day to lead with that goal in mind.

I recently joined Tucker Carlson and the buzz around my campaign has continued to gain tremendous momentum. I’m taking time from my busy schedule campaigning to write you this email, so even if you don’t send a gift, I’d really appreciate it if you’d read it in its entirety.
**[If you’d like to make a donation to continue my campaign’s momentum, you can do so here.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxdkcFu5CAMhp-G3BIlJkMmhxzajrrSrrbn9oQYDBnaACkhiubtF6JsK1VCIP4f7M-2GhrGGHS0O_cFDoIJrbAwA9QATQ11Q1vWNhU7Mzxd2VmLjlLAmrS1ssJMlWg2EYL3tpLeFrcBWqp7aHroe902ddN1jDaa6VritZYnLKbhFuO8EPpA4DmtRck1qGozLijMQZKmg1EOl9LrEv06llYsMRjhfPLQcvSOe8u3wNUky7jKD34N_D8xoc_C-tVFQi9wIsBCzhCMG5MQw6qStEbLrUKz2qTthRzi4tcgVRKdnLiw82T0_bBkugozuhx2T_SNlYlENBlrutvZyBxb8KMziVLJ3c2oKiRYnw4xqm_mI4V3Ue3gKX35m77aO-D1cUs2d5PBZPwQbwZTKy-vnTAvLf4twoDzZqbJLKxLMxr3GeXJHLUMpHskAPs3gH0I8Pm22bC-2z-_yjeG5Sd7sadswlPa431WXy-PINXRMSDd5R__Trs9)**
We covered a number of topics that I think every voter in PA should know about.
**The Establishment turning their back on a 30 year Army veteran.** I served our country honorably and led some of the best young men our nation has to offer, yet when I announced for Governor the political Establishment on both sides shunned me... it must mean I’m speaking the hard truths, but as our second President John Adams famously said “facts are stubborn things.” The political Establishment in our country is failing Republicans, Democrats, and everyone in between, and I’ll never bow to their go-along get-along agenda. They doubted me in the primary, but with the backing of the grassroots and patriots in Pennsylvania and across our country, I proved them wrong, and I’m going to do it again on November 8th.
**Unleashing Pennsylvania’s oil and gas reserves to jumpstart our economy on Day 1 of a Mastriano administration.** The answer to many of our economic woes is unleashing American energy dominance, and as Governor of Pennsylvania, on Day 1, I’ll have the power to open up drilling and fracking at a scale never seen before in our nation’s history. Joe Biden’s war on American energy got us into this mess, and Pennsylvania will be where the American energy comeback begins. | | | | [DONATE](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxdkU1v3CAQhn-NfbNlD2vYPfjQZpVKrRr12OSCWBh7aflwMMjaf1-w3EaqhEC8L8w8M4NjTykFRtj5UqtRUDGhqvUIHUDfQdeTEz31LT1TNdzoeRKMEFBdderQCm1a0W8iBO9tK72t7-PlxrqOTTAMhMKEl4FKZOdBMkkUG3pZm_Ee47JW5FMFz3mtKFPAdtMuoCpBsjYFjU6tjZ8a5dPcWLHGoIXz2VOWK--4t3wLHI1sYpK_-S3wv8QVeRbWJxcrcoWhAhpKhqDdnIUYEmYpRcstKp1s1vZCDnH1KUjMopOGC7sYPT0OS-ar0LMrYfdEH1iFSERdsMzDLlqW2IIfncmUKHe3oGLIsD4fYsYP5iOFdxF38Jy-Cfj1LS0_nra3bHNntMrGf-Jdq9zK608m9MtJfa_DqJZNG6NXyvKM5n1GZTJHLWPFPlcA-zeAfQjw_rrZkH7Zb1-aV6qad_pih2LCU97jY8F_L48g7dExqNj1D-q1vC8)
---
**Josh Shapiro’s record of failure when it comes to violent crime.**
Unlike Josh Shapiro, I’ve served in war zones, and right now Philadelphia looks more like a war zone than the city where American Democracy was born. Crime has gone up 40% since Shapiro took power as Attorney General. Videos have surfaced online showing bands of criminals with illegal automatic weapons hopping out of vans at gas stations in Philadelphia and stealing cars of innocent citizens. There’s one place criminals like that will be under a Mastriano Administration, the state penitentiary, where they will be serving maximum sentences.

**There are 12 Pennsylvanian’s dying everyday from Fentynal.**
Biden’s open border has drugs flowing into our country freely and it’s causing a drug epidemic in Pennsylvania. Dealers and traffickers of these lethal drugs will be in the same place as the criminals sticking up drivers at gunpoint, the penitentiary.

At the end of our interview, Tucker came to the same conclusion that everyone who knows me can testify to, I’m not a radical, I’m just a guy who loves his country and his state too much to let it be destroyed by the woke left. I could have ridden off into the sunset for a comfortable retirement with the love of my life, my wife Rebbie, but instead I’m here, fighting for you and your family. **[I’d be proud to call you a donor to my campaign if you’re in a position to give.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxdkU1v3CAQhn-NfbOFYRc7Bx_arpJD1Jyqqjkhlhm8NHw4GGRtfn2x5TZSJQTifWHmmRkcO8457Vk_PNQwSi41Qm1GSijtCCUdO_FT1_KBw_nKBy17xiiQ6kTQSWNb2a0yxhBcq4Krb-MVNQPQ5KFjICVnqhvkQHogGjmQM9Z2vKU0LxX7UtHHshZUOWK7Gh8RtiBF09Ggh6UJuoGQp8bJJUUjfSgeOAHBi-DEGgVa1aSs3sQ1ir_EFXuULmSfKnah54ryuGWIxk9FSDFjkXJywiGY7Iq2F3KIS8hRYRG9skK62Rp9PyxVrtJMfgu7J_rE2ohkMhuWvbvZqC22FEdnCiWq3d1QMRbYUA454SfzkSL4hDt4Sd-onx9ef_zI7qnYwlsDxfhPvBkorbz86qV5OcH3Oo4wr8Zas_C-zGjaZ7RN5qhlrPqvFaX7N0r3IdD319XF_Ns9PzWvHJp3_uLOm0m_lT3dZ_z38gjSHh2jVX_5Ax_Ivac)**

After 30 years in uniform serving our country, I know one thing, the fight to save our country is worth fighting. Nothing on earth has ever come close to the greatness of the promise of the American Dream, and I’m doing everything in my power to preserve it. I’d be honored if you joined me.

All eyes are on Georgia, and experts are saying that I'm one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection. While it's worrying, my focus has been, and always will be, getting things done for Georgians and bettering our nation.
But while I'm working in the Senate to lower costs for hardworking families, defend voting rights, and more, my opponent, Herschel Walker, is busying himself with fancy fundraisers and rallies alongside Donald Trump.
Now, everyone from _Politico_ to _FiveThirtyEight_ reports that _this_ race could decide Senate control, and the GOP is coming after me as its top target for defeat. They'll do and spend whatever it takes to flip my seat; GOP super PACs have already launched round after round of attack ads against me.

body:
| | | |
---
| STATEMENT OF GEOFF DIEHL AND LEAH ALLEN CONDEMNING CDC COVID VACCINE VOTE
"We strongly condemn action taken by the CDC today to add COVID-19 vaccines to the childhood immunization schedule. The CDC's action essentially leaves it up to each state to decide whether to choose a different approach than the mandate advised by the federal government. Massachusetts public health regulations are set up to follow the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) recommended immunization schedule. If elected Governor and Lieutenant Governor, we would seek to remove COVID shots from state vaccination requirements. Our executive policy will be that we will not force any person in our state to receive a COVID shot against their will, we will not require COVID vaccination as a condition of employment and we will not require children to receive a COVID shot to go to school. We also will continue to honor religious exemptions. People who know the risks of vaccination and who nevertheless wish to become vaccinated, in coordination with their medical advisor and in the case of a child their parent or guardian, are free to get the shot and we fully support them and their decision. Rather, we are in favor of freedom and free will. We believe the decision of whether someone should be receive medical care should be a choice made freely between them and their doctor, not a choice mandated by the state. The stakes of such a decision are increased exponentially when the patient in question is a child and where there are parental interests at stake. COVID mRNA vaccines remain experimental, and the long-term consequences of them are impossible to know. What we do know is that there are serious concerns about the effects of these vaccines on children and adolescents, who are at greatly-reduced risk from COVID but who are at increased potential risk of myocarditis and other serious health issues following vaccination. Without full knowledge of the frequency and severity of these risks - information which is impossible for anyone to know with confidence at this early stage - it is reckless and irresponsible to mandate that children and adolescents receive a vaccine against their will, and especially as a condition of attending a public school."
---
|
---
---
| Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen have made personal freedom a cornerstone of their campaign, including consistent opposition to COVID lockdowns and vaccine mandates. The issue is a particularly personal one for Leah Allen, who was forced out of her job as a Registered Nurse due to a vaccine mandate imposed on her by her employer.
Diehl and Allen have pledged that, if elected, they will immediately rehire state workers who lost their job due to vaccine mandates, and that they will terminate any bureaucrats who made the decision to impose vaccine mandates on state employees.
Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen will always stand up for your freedom, especially when it comes to your kids!

body:
I’m out in the district today, wrapping up some final campaign stops for the day, and wondering when I’ll get a response from Tony Gonzales about a debate in this race.

In case you missed it, I sent a certified letter to Tony a few weeks ago challenging him to a debate — and I haven’t received a response yet.

To be clear, I believe the people of TX-23 deserve to hear us debate about the issues that matter most. We should be debating the future of the energy industry here in Texas, and our plans for TX-23: rural development, immigration reform, border security, and gun safety.

But Tony is choosing to stay silent. And the truth is, his plans for TX-23 are supported by his big-money backers, not the families of this district.

Tony knows that if he debates me — I will prove him to be the fraudulent leader that he is. So here’s how you can help: Make a donation now to help us dial up the public pressure on Tony to take part in a debate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221020Debate_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=10&recurring=]

Tony’s voting record shows that he is only concerned with party politics. I believe we deserve a representative that is concerned about what’s best for the district.

I’m ready. And I’m fighting as hard as I can to unseat Tony in November. I’ve been traveling across the district meeting with voters, and the people WANT to see a debate between us.

The more noise we can make, the better. Rush $10 or any amount to help us send a message → https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221020Debate_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=10&recurring=true

Friend,

Ron DeSantis is America's Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he's called home since his birth.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zefqardfge6vhav9c68frp207vfa0h8fse12em0g_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs)
---

Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain. Ron graduated Cum Laude from Yale University with a B.S. in History.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zgijch2tpvpim4t0vjshbgk1q9bnqeaksqmt5df0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs)
---

After graduating from college, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4m0g09ncpudh9p1oo6d7k155g5e4lagtadu4q28_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs)
---
I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida. While on active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney's Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators. Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z7sfl2k8pv3vcubar501srr4rlpq5pj4v4ibqnjo_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs)
---
Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38% of the vote, Ron won his first three terms in Congress. While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Ron was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health. In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet - parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.
---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zu3n9146ns62khcqem701ns1gm0jqbu2nehtsga0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs)
---
Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world. In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years. I've watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.
---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z2vqp087gd59motgts9efman9nnhtsfbq7b9gdro_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs)
---
As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children - so as Governor, he passed legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business. As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state. But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn't. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn't have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**
---
| [](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zj2or4qdknrl05keqg6phhid4f82rse2r2scqld0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs)
---
He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands. Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They're fighting to take away parents' rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children. Ron's opponent has voted in support of the Biden regime 100% of the time in Congress. He's made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians - including children - defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left's woke ideologies. I can you tell Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs you to stand with him. [**_Will you stand with my husband today to protect our state? >>>_** ](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zmicsale9bdgjqnsn4k88so45ghvfqbvjaqc4648_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs) [**STAND WITH GOVERNOR DESANTIS >>>** ](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zo843dc3icdjplkr81d1j8edmkn952r0sma30ll0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c9ie4ob4cth2bs) Sincerely, Casey DeSantis
---

name: Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
subject: We need a historic turnout to win.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Today is the first day of in-person early voting in North Carolina. People are voting right now, and we have to treat every day of early voting like Election Day.
#

Friends -
Today is the first day of in-person early voting in North Carolina. People are voting right now, and we have to treat every day of early voting like Election Day.
It’s going to take a historic turnout in this race for us to win. It’s not easy to run the kind of grassroots organizing campaign that it takes to flip North Carolina. So we need to be doing all that we can to turn out our target voters and reach undecided voters before they cast their ballots.
[**Make a $3 donation to our campaign right now to help us ramp up our organizing in every corner of North Carolina. We would not ask if it were not critically important.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221020-1-subs&t=1&akid=2073%2E357359%2EpGqPw5)
**[DONATE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221020-1-subs&refcode2=2073.357359.pGqPw5&t=2&akid=2073%2E357359%2EpGqPw5)**
We cannot take anything for granted right now. The polling shows we are tied, and a handful of votes could decide this race — just like we saw in Cheri’s 2020 race for Chief Justice.
More than half of the votes in this race are expected to be cast during early voting — long before Election Day gets here. In the past two statewide election cycles, more than 65% of votes were cast prior to Election Day.
That means we need to do a lot of work right now as millions of people are about to fill out their ballots. So we are trying to spend aggressively on voter contact, advertising and events across the state with Cheri.
[**Will you make a $3 donation today to help us fund our efforts to reach and turn out the voters that we need to win North Carolina? Please know that every dollar you contribute will be put to work immediately to elect Cheri Beasley to the U.S. Senate.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221020-1-subs&t=3&akid=2073%2E357359%2EpGqPw5)

name: Barbra Streisand
subject: time to get off the sidelines
body:
Derek,
I’ve long wished we lived in a time when laws were not necessary to safeguard us from inequality. But laws – and the elected officials who write them – are what determine access to the voting booth, whether someone can have a safe abortion, or how much you pay for prescription drugs.
I’m committed to electing lawmakers who believe that everyone deserves a fair shot at getting ahead and staying ahead, and I have to tell you that I’m concerned by what I’m seeing in New Hampshire and Republicans’ ruthless efforts to oust Democratic Senator Maggie Hassan.
Maggie won her last election by just 1,017 votes, and Mitch McConnell and his allies have spent more attacking her than any other Democrat up for reelection this year. Before I go on, can you please chip in to her campaign and CommonGood ? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan]
Let me make this clear. If Maggie Hassan hadn’t won her last election, the Affordable Care Act would’ve been repealed, and Republicans would currently hold the Senate majority.
There are a lot of Republicans – all in lockstep with Mitch McConnell – who will do anything to win this year. They know that if they defeat Maggie, they regain control of the Senate chamber.
No one has ever regretted getting off the sidelines. And now, with the most extreme Republican party of my lifetime teetering on the edge of regaining power, we need all hands on deck. Please rush $25 or as much as you can to Maggie Hassan and CommonGood to protect the Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan]
[http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mha?refcode=20221020_CGVA_Hassan]
Thank you,
Barbra

body:
We launched the Big Fights Fund – your one stop for contributing to our team’s effort to get out the vote and have real, tangible conversations with voters ahead of Election Day.

Hey Derek, it’s Josh Shapiro. We are 19 days out from Election Day, which means one thing: there’s nothing more important than making sure every Pennsylvanian is ready to cast their ballot. Our team is recruiting volunteers, running text banks, persuading voters on social media, and working overtime to make sure that our message is being heard by every Pennsylvanian. This is the most important part of the election cycle and it requires a lot of resources to get it right. body:
| | | |
---
| _**Hide is Closing Down!!!**_
---
|
---
| We’re glad that our petition back in April of this year, which gathered hundreds of signatures from Buckhead residents, made an impact. I will do whatever is necessary to keep us safe in Buckhead and Metro Atlanta if elected to Congress. Over the past few years, multiple people have been shot and killed at Hide.

They were running drugs and guns out of there, and there were reports of treating customers differently based on the color of their skin.

I won’t say they’re closing purely because of the public pressure we imposed, but we definitely had an impact. Please read the full judgment on Fulton County public records for the full story why they’re closing.
---
|

|
---

Will Oregon continue to tackle climate change, hold big polluters accountable, and protect our environment? Or, will we go backward? OLCV-endorsed candidates are ready to protect what we love about Oregon today and for future generations. **[Check out the full list of OLCV-endorsed candidates and ballot measures here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52979129/374059914/-466892316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQwNTkzZmM1LWFlNTAtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGUwOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xxgLvZY1B2-U0F6azoBZxY4sgUZQl-gukShgKMt_zoo=&emci=ecbdc2bb-9550-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=d0593fc5-ae50-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2107230)** OLCV has endorsed climate champions up and down the ballot. And there are big statewide endorsements on every Oregon voter’s ballot. _Oregon League of Conservation Voters (OLCV) Statewide Endorsements_
U.S. Senator **Ron Wyden**
**Tina Kotek** for Governor
**Christina Stephenson** for Labor Commissioner
**Vote YES** on Measures 111, 112, and 113 If you haven’t yet heard about Tina Kotek, well, she is exactly the leader we need as our next governor. **Tina is the only candidate who will meet the climate crisis with the urgency necessary.** As governor, Tina will be an effective leader driven by her core values of justice, opportunity for all, and protecting our climate for future generations. Maybe you’ve heard about Tina, but have you heard about Christina? **OLCV has endorsed Christina Stephenson for labor commissioner because she will protect workers and our environment.** She will help expand apprenticeship programs in clean energy jobs, helping grow our clean energy economy. Ready to vote yes on statewide ballot measures? subject: It's Time for All Americans to put Country Over Party!
body:
Let's unite and vote Democratic regardless of party affiliation | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f0877f4e1e29/test-email-meet-mike-ford-the-democrat-running-in-ga-890?e=e60663a86e)
---
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=e21201ecdc&e=e60663a86e)
# Mike Ford, the Democrat Running for
US Congress in GA-09
US Army Vietnam Veteran. Lawyer for 46 years. Husband, father, grandfather.
Dedicated to defend the US Constitution, our rights, and our freedoms.
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=ed6d37220f&e=e60663a86e)
**I ’m Mike Ford, the Democrat running for US Congress in GA-09 **and I’m working diligently every day to pull off an epic upset to unseat extremist Republican incumbent, Rep Andrew Clyde, but I need your help. **The sobering truth is that by-and-large, the vast majority of elected Republicans** have gone lock-step down the right-wing rabbit hole of extremism, unhinged "Q" conspiracy theories, and dangerous anti-democracy, anti-American authoritarianism. What the MAGA-wing of the Republican party has become isn't who we are as Americans. As free people, a nation if immigrants, we are better than the hate, bigotry, racism, sexism, transphobia that extremist Republicans use to whip-up their angry base looking for the next marginalized group to target their rage and fear.**As Americans, we need to unite and put country over party.** I've traveled around Georgia’s 9th District and I know there are a lot of good-hearted Republicans who love their country, but they’ve fallen for the insidious disinformation, misinformation, and lies peddled on Fox News, right-wing talk radio, and on social media. **I am reaching out, asking you to please talk to those good folks in your life.** As a patriotic US Army Veteran who took an oath to defend our US Constitution, I'm asking all eligible voters, Democrats, Independents, and yes, Republicans, for the sake of our nation and to defend our very Democracy, please vote Democratic this year regardless of your political affiliation. Please forward them this email to them, share it on social media. Thank you for your support, your help, and your vote.With Sincere Gratitude,
Mike Ford
[**mike4georgia.com**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=c67657a82a&e=e60663a86e)
|
---
**My Extremist Republican Opponent, Rep Clyde Votes Against All Infants, Veterans, Seniors, Consumers. ****Rep Andrew Clyde has a proven track record of being extreme for the sake of being downright cruel to people**. At every opportunity, Rep Clyde has shown a callous indifference, if not outright contempt, for women, seniors, Veterans, infants, and consumers of every political stripe, all of us.**Clyde is running to the far right of his fellow Republicans on almost every issue.** He voted against legislation to help provide baby formula during a supply chain crisis. He was one of 174 Republicans to vote against legislation to provide medical care to Iraq and Afghanistan Veterans suffering long-term illnesses from exposure to toxic burn pits. He was one of 49 Republicans who in September, just voted against Veterans again, voting against food security for homeless and disabled Veterans. He voted against lowering the cost of insulin and other prescription drugs. He voted against legislation to stop oil/gas companies from price gouging consumers at the pump. There is no excuse for and no end to his cruel, callous “Nay” votes.**It’s time to vote out Republicans, not just in GA-09 but in every district.**
|
---
**On Your Mark. Get Set. Go Vote!****Early voting is happening in Georgia right now through November 4th!** You never know if bad weather, car trouble, or a family/work emergency will prevent you from voting on Election Day so don’t delay, please vote early. **Election Day is Tuesday, Nov 8.** Democracy is not a spectator sport, as citizens of the United States of America, it is our civic duty to vote and to help others vote.There are great candidates up-down-and-across the ballot in every district. It’s been my pleasure to meet with so many candidates including Marcus Flowers, the Democrat taking on Marjorie Taylor Greene in GA-14 and William Boddie, the Democrat running for statewide office as Labor Commissioner. To preview your full ballot of all candidates + ballot initiatives, simply go to [**www.ballotpedia.org**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=8100e66b42&e=e60663a86e) click on “2022 Elections” then click on “Preview My Ballot” then enter your address. When voting, don’t stop at the top, vote blue the entire ballot.
|
---
**You’re Invited to a Meet-and-Greet in Suwanee, GA****Join Mike Ford, Josh Uddin, Louisa Shell Jackson and other candidates for a free Meet-and-Greet event on Thursday Oct 27th in Suwanee.** You don’t have to live in Suwanee to join. Simply click the invite photo or the link below to learn more and RSVP. We would love to see you there! [**RSVP to attend**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=e5b1c30b28&e=e60663a86e)

name: Adam Schiff
subject: re: Louis DeJoy
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
| A federal judge has ruled that DeJoy’s changes to the U.S. Postal Service before the 2020 election harmed mail delivery and impeded voting by mail at the height of the pandemic.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=1135%2E5257348%2EeIPvVG)
Derek, I know that you have long wanted Trump’s handpicked Postmaster General Louis DeJoy to be fired. _Frankly, I have too. Sadly, though, he’s still there._
And as millions of Americans vote by mail across the country, it’s critically important that we all understand this next point:
**A federal judge has ruled that DeJoy’s changes to the U.S. Postal Service before the 2020 election harmed mail delivery and impeded voting by mail at the height of the pandemic.**
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20221020-dejoy-petition-vsp.5w67Co&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20221020_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=4&akid=1135%2E5257348%2EeIPvVG)
The judge ruled that states, counties, and cities that filed suit against DeJoy proved that his delays affected their ability to provide safe alternatives to in-person voting at the height of the pandemic.
And DeJoy bypassed regulators he was required to notify of any changes.
**DeJoy’s general counsel at the Postal Service used strongarm tactics to intimidate states and threaten that if they did not pay first class postage on ballots, then voters may not receive them in time to vote by mail.**
DeJoy was a Republican National Committee money man. A personal ally of the disgraced, twice-impeached ex-president. An executive for a direct competitor to the USPS. It’s unconscionable that he is still running the USPS two years later as Americans are once again voting by the millions.
[**Derek, please add your name to my petition demanding Louis DeJoy’s removal as Postmaster General by the USPS Board of Governors.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20221020-dejoy-petition-vsp.5w67Co&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20221020_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=5&akid=1135%2E5257348%2EeIPvVG)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20221020-dejoy-petition-vsp.5w67Co&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20221020_AM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=6&akid=1135%2E5257348%2EeIPvVG)
---
We’ve long known that DeJoy’s conflicts of interest and loyalty to the GOP partisans made him unfit to serve as Postmaster General — now a federal judge has ruled that his leadership directly impacted our voting rights.
Enough is enough. It’s time for DeJoy to go.
Thanks for joining me in calling for a USPS that puts public service above DeJoy’s private, personal interests.
— Adam
150 E. Olive Ave., Suite 208 Burbank CA, 91502

Peter,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=386ee8a83faf44ccbbb77f4e9a39ed9d&_e=0BgITmolTE1u67NnIPiVSIC8Gzf0Iz1ZS5OaW9f4S-hwOC9Ysb7wGTGt-vG5s5qjly2XrZgjmUmAZD3rr3f60aVsaH8gbNhDBk35Q06gCOD4-6kEZ4K8CLk7hAA7Dutt_I0b22Tuln3ykIE3SppfsSH6y9WqyGe6BtAOIwZiBQ3juck-P332qQAUAwk1mOzezSU13SWg6V96euFVJFcVTcxseZaJsZz6B7j3Cw_V7fj4iF95r-e17X6Sp5Nz3jUHGeSMPheCu8B2Xd_u2UxYdovIaH-cSDAWsG6n3QXsxWbezRINX0NkG7IkZVyZHSKhphtvFhIMwqG1XR8KuEAnSEUi0mdW0gYPzDXiZqkdMAAmuM5u7Vfq9AdOZYFpXf88)
While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments **(sometimes for as little as $28)** , a protester in the crowd said of me:

| _**"He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_
---

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight.

Friend –
I am writing today to humbly ask if you can make a $5 contribution to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and expand the Democratic majority.
Let me be clear:
Flipping Wisconsin's Senate seat this November is not a given. It's going to take an incredible amount of work to make it possible.
You can count on me to work as hard as possible to defeat Ron Johnson. But I cannot win this race alone.

His promise has still not been fulfilled. As I stood and looked out across the river to the East Side of Bridgeport, I couldn’t help but think how this is a stark reminder of WHY I am running. With infrastructure needs, congested highways and public housing crumbling before our very eyes, my opponent pledges funding without shepherding these projects to become a reality for our residents of Southwestern Connecticut. He stays in Washington as our part of the state suffers. During my years of public service on a local, regional and state level, I worked collaboratively to problem solve CT’s most pressing issues. I truly understand the needs and impacts at the most local level. As your Congresswoman, I will never make a pledge or promise to you without seeing it through to the finish line. It was announced yesterday that after 25 years of a broken bridge, the City of Bridgeport was finally issued a permit to proceed with replacing the Congress Street Bridge. If my campaign's highlighting of this issue helped to spur state action, I am very pleased. The repair will be an important win for Bridgeport. The Congress Street Bridge, like so many other concerns in Connecticut, can be fixed. I will be your CHAMPION in Washington, and I will ensure DC works for us. For me, there is no other reason to be in Washington except to help Connecticut families, businesses, and communities, and to ensure a vibrant and safe future for our state and our nation. Today, we are closer to victory than ever. With LESS THAN THREE WEEKS TO GO, we need YOUR help. Join #TeamJayme and sign up for our, or! I look forward to building a working bridge to Congress that serves all of Connecticut. body:
**I 'm facing an extreme anti-choice opponent who wants to ban abortion even in cases of rape and incest.**
Peter,

Since the Supreme Court ripped away reproductive rights by overturning the landmark _Roe v. Wade_ case, we've seen just how devastating this decision has been.

Immediately following the ruling, women in more than half the states in the country have lost the freedom to make the most profoundly impactful healthcare decision of their lives - when and whether to have a child. And Republicans in other states are working to pass restrictive legislation, meaning access to abortion is at risk for even more women. But Republicans in Congress want to go even further, proposing a national abortion ban.

Here in Washington's 8th District, I'm running against anti-choice extremist Matt Larkin. Larkin wants to ban abortion even in cases of rape and incest, and even said, **" I could see a strong conservative Congress putting forward that vote to ban it nationally."**

[**We can 't let anti-choice extremists ban abortion nationally. As a doctor and as a congresswoman, I will always fight for access to reproductive health care. But election experts are calling this race a "toss up" and if my opponent flips this seat red, he'll work to ban abortion nationally. I need your help to ensure that doesn't happen.

**[The future of reproductive rights is on the line this November. Will you split a donation between my campaign and Derek's to help me defeat my extreme opponent so I can continue fighting to protect abortion access?](https://act.myngp.com/el/lZTm1Rx3i0WrSyFU11rZX1kpt40oNoxjHCwTB9EFiOk=/3g-ckEDISo0VUAH-bwRv65PApZzWEED3Q6fhtZHaKZ0=?refcode=em22_221020_aborti_fndt_gq_act___DrKS_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221020_aborti_fndt_gq_act___DrKS_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})**

Fellow Conservative: The Left is losing it. The polls are moving. Joe Biden and the woke socialists are flailing. **Conservatives are winning.**
_Do you know how you can tell?_
Just turn on the news. The media only talks about the past. They want to make the November elections about Covid or Donald Trump or January 6 -- anything but their own record.
They know _**they**_ are responsible for inflation, the border chaos, the crime wave, and the collapse of our school system. _They talk about the past, so they don 't have to discuss the present._
**But conservatives know this election is really about the future.**
**[Fight for America's future! Support SCF today!](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d39c933201304bb8af1e6c33c6318cfe&_e=U0EHIIfJeb2LYJrFWUjaCULF7jzqXF1QyLaJ6rjhVNaNKjBARTlU2SOomZMvixW1V3sAa1KdR9su0kCc_EW6LmrpRl5J6hrlqXJYBxckRpQBs7BAm9P2ZATLZUmNlTMii9rRdFPCcNm0zeV5mR-7qLMyXpvoCypDTPrtFHg584X20bWs6HpEZ7V-n5DC9MN7QYuw50pjh58Qgl5kE_giRb2dPWTHPakcPqWn7vsfjmDYqt5ZFHMkLwbyfq3iXapPLTRZnWIeuBOUZ0VIgnaPHb_yIpi3B0aGiA16HJjXjZ3-KPu6RUBqMHPvi6FzSqjn)** In 2022, SCF candidates are building something we've never seen before. They represent a new crop of young leaders, hardened by the Culture Wars, done with the establishment of both parties, and ready to fight for a different kind of politics.
This is not your father's conservative movement. Today, we have political newcomers like Herschel Walker, proven leaders like Ted Budd, incumbent heroes like Ron Johnson, Rand Paul, and Mike Lee, and rising stars like Adam Laxalt and Eric Schmitt.
**[Support the Senate Conservatives today!](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d39c933201304bb8af1e6c33c6318cfe&_e=U0EHIIfJeb2LYJrFWUjaCULF7jzqXF1QyLaJ6rjhVNaNKjBARTlU2SOomZMvixW1V3sAa1KdR9su0kCc_EW6LmrpRl5J6hrlqXJYBxckRpQBs7BAm9P2ZATLZUmNlTMii9rRdFPCcNm0zeV5mR-7qOUAerKZ1kZvjesebSDMgYnTkHua4gIPUfAj_pbJ-ugVkQBHq4gBicw1suP-z1KVcLf4T84Xdc0qQDHFMJ6xKOyiLySeNckceIzySfSSelAJvqJiO8VMdLHuYfMZnQrXbdxOK6iO8nOD7rOJm0EjLQt2cPlxlBgGreFAIyXr7c4I)**

In 2022, we are seeing a new conservative movement rise for a new conservative moment.
_**Welcome to Generation Right.**_
This generation is not here to protect Big Business or cut deals with Democrats. In the Senate, they are going to expose the corruption of both. They're going to subpoena Big Tech oligarchs and uncover their manipulation of our elections.
**[Break up the Swamp-oply: Support SCF and help build a Conservative Senate!](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d39c933201304bb8af1e6c33c6318cfe&_e=U0EHIIfJeb2LYJrFWUjaCULF7jzqXF1QyLaJ6rjhVNaNKjBARTlU2SOomZMvixW1V3sAa1KdR9su0kCc_EW6LmrpRl5J6hrlqXJYBxckRpQBs7BAm9P2ZATLZUmNlTMii9rRdFPCcNm0zeV5mR-7qKdFCI7e1khxO4tgMPFaznYac6OY9t_sHndndhfUCievq3CIjuFg0R3rLMyIn9sjpcX2PxwTQBFGehMc23AcC2up8tSJ7nyjZBeeHppC5UDwlGB6Z9EQcxo7kaYb-RFQo4E5suuu3uZp-nv0sU7dSNfCmswSofILhLZk79fZUzpq)**
They're going to reform our broken education and immigration systems. They're going to end woke discrimination against conservatives and Christians. They're going to unlock American energy and defund anti-American bigotry. They're going to Back the Blue and defend the unborn and girls' sports. When we win, the Left's free ride - from sanctuary cities to Covid corruption to critical race theory - will be cut off.
No more money. No more bailouts. No more coverups!
**These conservatives are not coming TO the Swamp; they are coming FOR The Swamp. And SCF is behind them all the way. **
**[Join us.
