| Friend,
I’m John Gibbs, former Trump administration official and member of the 1776 Commission. In August, with President Trump's endorsement, I won the Republican nomination in Michigan’s 3rd Congressional District by defeating Republican impeachment voter Peter Meijer.
**_I spent a lot of time writing this email to you, and it would mean a lot to me if you’d read it._**
There are three weeks and two distinct phases left in this campaign. Between now and the end of October, undecided voters will be choosing the candidate they are supporting. Then, in the final week of the election my campaign will be orchestrating a massive mobilization effort to get every Republican in the district out to vote.
Michigan’s 3rd district is one of the few seats in the country held by a Republican that Nancy Pelosi is targeting to flip Democrat in their “Red to Blue” program. During redistricting, our Republican voter registration advantage was washed away and now we’re in one of the few true swing districts left in the country.
The next two weeks are critically important to our success. Right now, our internal polls show the race within the margin of error, but neither me nor my opponent Hillary Scholten (more on her later) is above 50%, which means the remaining undecided voters will likely determine who wins this election.
If they break for me by a 70%-30% margin, we win. It’s as simple as that, but it won’t be without a fight. We have powerful positive ads that are winning over undecided voters every time they air on TV, but outside groups are attacking me mercilessly on just about every TV channel and website that exists and overshadowing my positive ads.
I am in serious need of help from grassroots supporters to bolster my final advertising campaign aimed at winning over the remaining undecided voters. **[If you’d like to help, you can make a secure contribution here.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxdkU9v3CAQxT-NfbOFZ72wPviQdpscKuXWSj0hDGOWhD8ONnG3n77YdXKohJB4Dx6_mcG-oZTC5dx2Xal6QcWIqjQ9EICGAGkYadumHplgKKgcOkIUE7JoCTphbC2aVcQYgqtlcOWtp-fmBOJCqSRMMryQjgJhYmAjaaEbxtL2t2WZ5uL0UMBjXjPKFLFejY-otpCsvYSbr7QZhrkaQ6xk8DriPFfGy83VXAXPg-Nr5Ghlld75EPkHcXF6FC4kvxSnK5wLoHH7IRqvs7DEhFlKi-MOlUkua3shhziHFCVm0UvLhZusGe-HJfNRGO232P2jf4Qbi1jMBmTvbjJyyxX86ErmQ7m7ySuURqF6DwvGOROHV4xC4yc41yFo-4GXi15wLyKjVD_l69OP-U96zg2g3FujsvGfeDMqt_Ua3INUK3wrY6-m1VhrZsryvPQ-r21KR119wb4UAPszgH0g8PZrdTG9uO9PVUt-V2_02Z03E77mfblP-HnzCKmP7kHBrn8BYKHBgQ)**
Now a little bit about my opponent. Hilary Scholten is a former Department of Justice attorney with the full support and financial backing of Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden. The absolute last thing we need is another corrupt, elitist bureaucrat in Congress imposing their extremist policies on the everyday Americans they hold such contempt for.
Unlike Hillary, I don’t think I’m above you or better than you and I never will. As a Christian I know that every human being is created in God’s image, and the only thing that separates us is what we do with our lives.
Since graduating from Stanford University, I’ve devoted my life to serving God and my fellow man. I served as a Christian missionary in Japan, in the Trump Administration where I served under Dr. Ben Carson at HUD as we worked to free people from the grips of government dependence, and now, as I run for Congress to stop our country from careening off the cliff we’re headed for.
As of the last filing, my opponent has a huge cash advantage with less than 3 weeks left... BUT, I’ve proven that I can be outspent and still win. I just need to raise enough money to fully execute my campaign strategy, and as of today, we need to raise a little over $250,000 dollars between now and election day to make that happen.
**[Are you able to help by making a generous donation of $50, $100, or even $1,000? It could make the difference in one of the closest races in the country.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxdkU-PnSAUxT-N7jSIiLpwMdPX6aJJ1-2KIFx5TPnjIIx9375onVk0ISScA4ffvRemhlKKh46MYyknTvkCstQTRhg3CKOmR4Q09dLzHjgV84iQ7LkoCALLtal5s_MQvLe18La8Tw3BYuiGZphJi1o0jrIbRoFQj9GwSEJLM91jXLeifSrwS14biBSg3rULII-QrL36u6uUnuetWnyohHcqwLZV2onDVUx6x7xle2BgRJXe2RzYB3HRvnDrk4tFe8NdgWk4fgjaqSzEkCBLKVpmQepks3YWcombT0FAFp0wjNvV6OVxWSIfuVbuiD0_-kd4sPCoDyDzsKsWRy5nV1cyH4jTTU6C0BLku48Qtkzsf0PgCj7BmfJemQ-8XHSEs4iMUhE-DGoJt58028wZLbPxn3jXMrf15u2TkDv-WoZJrrs2Rm-0z_NS57yOKV11TUX_XGB8PsP4HAh--7XbkF7t928VQX-qN_rDdoeJv-Q9Plb4vHmF1Ff3cNHf_gJ09r95)**
The last person Nancy Pelosi wants in Congress is a conservative Black man who isn’t afraid of the media or the Democratic Party, and that’s exactly what I am and it’s exactly why she’s spending so much money to defeat me.
**[So, I’m asking for your financial support of whatever you can afford to help us keep this seat in Republican hands and save our country from Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi’s disastrous agenda.](http://email.email.a1warroom.com/c/eJxdkc2O3CAQhJ8G32xhbMPMwYdNZjeHSFEukZITYqDNsOHHg_E68_YBx7uHSAiJKii-7oaxpZSS09Cfz5UaBRUTqMqMBBPSYoJbhvu-bSYmGAgqr2eMFRMS9RicMLYR7SZiDME1MrjqNophahkVgg2YMei6ifWkPU0SiBwYPfWVHW8pzQvqnhB5yWsBuUZoNuMjqBKStddw87U21-tSTyHWMngdYVlq42VxNVfB8-D4FjlYWa9v_Br5OzHqXoQLq0-ou5ABERrLD9F4nYUUV8jSmhx3oMzqsrYXcohLWKOELHppuXCzNdPjsGQ-CqN9id0_-kdYWEQyBcg-3GxkyRX86ErmA7m7q1cgjQL1FhLEJROH3xCFhg9wrkPQ9h0vF51gLyKj1FMS8efd_fj-nG3urVHZ-E-8GZXbegnuSaqNPFdxVPNmrDULZXleep9XmdJR14jYJ0TI_oyQfSDk_mtzcX11X7_UPf5T3-k3NxSTfM57eszwcfMIaY7uEcQufwHQ5sGt)**

Given all that is at stake this election cycle, we can’t diminish the importance of any seat up for grabs in November. If we want a shot of making Kyrsten Sinema and her obstructive, archaic filibuster irrelevant, we have to keep our Senate majority, AND add two Democratic seats. This is what we mean when we say **EVERY. SEAT. COUNTS!** One race not getting enough attention is Cheri Beasley’s in North Carolina. Beasley is running against Ted Budd, a self-described “conservative warrior” who has embraced Donald Trump, election denialism, and extreme abortion bans. In fact, Budd isn’t content just spreading lies about the 2020 election: he’s also already spreading lies about the 2022 election, laying the groundwork to challenge the results if his opponent wins. We can’t afford to let another of Trump’s hand-picked, extreme MAGA candidates join the Senate. ******[Can you split a contribution between Cheri Beasley and Save the Senate so we can keep our democracy secure?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqcJuDX2HRji8zceUQ74uMWKxMHyt_snGQs7z7134w703Z2TkohnYkE6DC7orw2GZl-sChbsx1VpH3Paw3nGbwg2s0SRO9QcJ4ielxVWyEcnX_pUOuyax9TWqm9MdRUeNI-Hx6tFwhh9FOH_U68jybfOmwpyRNp_ncb4QyIDxI2FRIZAlU26DWeCZQxKWCAszHZYlNpj5PT7vBYD6Xa_wwP-vR-WhHmDJm4bGIvU38scCG-0W7FhKDEapmr3uUNbB12fumWbXnweYRGYZVUBpkiHzjmeir8notMINJgZbXTALTZ3qpHMuFSKSolVkZZtor5xw0rhSUKVHtpOG2ELW4LAQBpidayq2j68iTOOvAHiYctnSeYNRds340R7cxBIA/3qg/cObuJtpaS_KQ6SiIMqfmrw/h1/ffNhMuavbTCOov6LKA-3QC5dbEmxu0kQ4A-0MMv8t-o)**
This race has been close since the day it started. But Beasley is running a strong campaign and she’s looked upon favorably in a notoriously red state: a former state chief justice, Beasley won statewide twice and she has a good shot of winning in November. She’d be the first Black senator from North Carolina and only the third Black woman senator in U.S. history.

body:
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52984838/374082170/379053316?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk782-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYzRkNDNkYS1iYTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rAkhWrRahXg4EHkspkPcWLOFlwKF99lZxpGWG0cYHH4=)
I get that I’m not who you were expecting to hear from, Peter.

You might be wondering why the guy who played Ben Wyatt in “Parks and Recreation” and Mark Scout in “Severance” is emailing you right before the election, but today I’m reaching out to you as a concerned citizen – not as an actor.

**In just 19 days, New Yorkers will decide whether to re-elect Attorney General Letitia James or replace her with her conspiracy-touting, MAGA-supported Republican opponent. **

name: John Fetterman
subject: “Stupid little fake tattoos”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Let’s talk about them.
#
Derek,
Last month, Tucker Carlson went on a nearly 20-minute-long rant about me. The whole thing was as unhinged as you’d expect, but one line that stood out was about my tattoos.
**“All your stupid little fake tattoos,” he said, calling them a “costume.”**
**[In a moment, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 or more to my grassroots campaign. But first, let’s talk about those tattoos Tucker seems to be so interested in.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221020-2?amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode=em20221020-7813&refcode2=7813_434096_NQbElq&akid=7813%2E434096%2ENQbElq)**
**[Add A Donation Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221020-2?refcode=em20221020-7813&refcode2=7813_434096_NQbElq&akid=7813%2E434096%2ENQbElq)**
I have nine dates tattooed on my right forearm. Each one is a day on which someone died violently in Braddock, Pennsylvania, while I was mayor. **Gun violence and violent crime might be jokes to someone like Tucker, but they are very real to people in towns like Braddock.**
The first one that I tattooed on my arm is “01.16.06.” That’s the date on which Christopher Williams was shot dead while delivering pizzas. This was a man about my age at the time. He had a 12-year-old daughter. I just couldn’t get over the fact that he was never going home to her.
Another tattoo reads “02.03.07,” the date that 23-month-old Nyia Page was found dead after her father sexually assaulted her and left her in the bitter cold. Her tiny footprints in the snow led an officer to her body. And I have “09.16.13,” the date Derrail Roilton, a father of two, was found dead in the yard next to his mother’s home after being shot three times.
These murders and tragic deaths in Braddock, and others in similar towns and cities across Pennsylvania, became so normal that they were a talking point in our elected leaders’ speeches and footnotes in media stories.
**That’s why I have these tattoos. They are not some “costume.” They are reminders of the people we have lost and what I am fighting for. Both the dates on my right arm and the “15104” on my left — Braddock’s ZIP code — are personal to me.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221020-2?amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode=em20221020-7813&refcode2=7813_434096_NQbElq&akid=7813%2E434096%2ENQbElq)
My decision to mark these deaths with tattoos was inspired in part by their permanence — the fact that these people, their stories and my town will be with me forever. I get that etching art permanently onto your body isn’t how most politicians would express their connection to their communities. But I don’t care about what anyone else thinks. It felt right to me.
I care deeply about my community and the people I represent. As mayor, I always felt a sense of obligation and responsibility for tragedies that happened under my watch.
**I put these dates on my arm because I realized that we had lost the shock of these deaths.** We became numb. I did it because I never saw the media or the public at large caring about these victims, most of them young Black men.
During my tenure as mayor, Braddock, which saw three homicides in the year before I became mayor, went 5 1⁄2 years without the loss of life through gun violence. We made a difference and we saved lives. It’s my proudest accomplishment in public service.
**I was a hands-on mayor and showed up at almost every crime scene because I felt a sense of duty to our community. I wanted to do everything I could to keep my town safe.**
That’s one of the core differences between my opponent for the U.S. Senate, Mehmet Oz, and me.
While he was making millions of dollars peddling "miracle cures" from a TV studio in Manhattan and living in a mansion on a hill in New Jersey, I was rolling up my sleeves and putting in the work to make my community safer. **I’m the only candidate in this race who has fought violent crime and won.**
**[If you’re ready to defeat Dr. Oz and send a real fighter for PA to the U.S. Senate, I need your support. Will you consider pitching in your first $5 today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221020-2?amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode=em20221020-7813&refcode2=7813_434096_NQbElq&akid=7813%2E434096%2ENQbElq)**
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221020-2?refcode=em20221020-7813&refcode2=7813_434096_NQbElq&akid=7813%2E434096%2ENQbElq)**
The stories of the people whose lives we tragically lost still are with me every single day — not just on my arm but in every decision I make as an elected official.
They remind me of why I am here and why I’m doing this.
Thanks for hearing me out,
John
John Fetterman
Lt. Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Senate

body:
I firmly believe that kitchen table issues have kitchen table solutions.
| | |
---
Peter, as a kid, no matter how busy my mom and dad were, we always sat down as a family to eat dinner together.
When I became a parent myself, I carried on this same tradition with my own family, and there was always an open seat and a full plate for anyone who wanted to join us.
While the food was usually delicious (especially once my son Matt started doing the cooking), the best part of dinner was always the conversation. **We came together as a family around the kitchen table to celebrate wins, talk through problems, and identify solutions – from the highs and lows of high school to the issues facing our country.** It was a time to pray together, reflect together, grieve together, laugh together, find connection, and dream big as a team.
**I firmly believe that kitchen table issues have kitchen table solutions.** If you want to solve the problems that a community, state, or country faces, you should start by pulling up a chair and listening to the conversations families have over dinner.
Although I wish I could invite every single person on this team over to my own kitchen table, unfortunately, with the election just around the corner, that's not feasible. **[So instead, I'm inviting you to participate in my Dinner Table Priorities survey. Please, can you take just a moment to complete my survey before 11:59 p.m. tonight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52987840/374092102/1334226984?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk410-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjIxNDQzZi1jMzUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=R_4DqEjw9HhGcW_KE2DuDKOZSziZ08bd6p7t1QVIjh0=&emci=955b8870-524e-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=5221443f-c350-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=4450063)**

That's why input from grassroots supporters has always been so central to this campaign. **And now, as we head into the final days of this election, I need to hear from you again – to hear what problems your family faces, what worries keep you up at night, and what you're most hopeful for. **

body:
These are perilous times. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-9445871?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

These are perilous times. Be sober, be vigilant.

The FBI and other alphabet soup government agencies are at war with everyday Americans. We’re closer to nuclear war than we’ve been in almost sixty years. And to top it off, heavily armed and dangerous drug cartels are exploiting the border crisis to push drugs into our country like never before.

The Center for Renewing America isn’t sitting idly by as progressives destroy our country.

We have actionable plans to stop deep state entities from harassing Americans, reset our foreign policy to avoid a devastating nuclear conflict, and crush the cartels.
---
|
---
| **WATCH: Congress Must Create a #ChurchCommittee**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=20ebbc104d&e=17913c7d6d)
---

The federal government’s national security apparatus is being **__weaponized__** against the American people. The FBI, the CIA, the DOJ, and the DHS are on the attack against church-going, patriotic Americans.

Thankfully, we have a plan to **_STOP them dead in their tracks_**. Our new video makes the case that a new Congress must create a “Church Committee” to rein in these out of control, corrupt federal agencies. [Watch the video ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=c2fc672c4e&e=17913c7d6d)[here](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=20eda3e55d&e=17913c7d6d).

The Church Committee was created in the 1970’s and investigated abuses by American intelligence agencies in both domestic and foreign affairs. As I told Fox News after the Mar-a-Lago raid, a new Congress must “ _prepare a Church-style commission... to dismantle the FBI into a thousand bits._ ”

Our very own Jeff Clark echoed my remarks to Fox News by saying the incoming Congress must “** _turn the FBI upside down_**.” It’s time to end the woke and weaponized national security apparatus. This is the way to do it.
|
---
| **Russia-Ukraine: To Avoid Nuclear War, We MUST Put America First**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=18a83e6a53&e=17913c7d6d)
---
Instead of provoking a dangerous global conflict, our government should be focused on avoiding nuclear war with Russia. We’re as close to a nuclear conflict as we’ve been since the Cuban Missile Crisis. A **[new writeup](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ce6b05c3d0&e=17913c7d6d)** by our very own CRA Visiting Fellow William Wolfe in _The Federalist_ makes the case for why the US should avoid further escalation.

_“American interests demand we act accordingly to avoid a nuclear confrontation with Russia. But in response to the ratcheted-up rhetoric from the Russians, it appears we have lost our collective minds. Has it been decreed by the powers that be that it’s worth risking a nuclear holocaust over the Donbas? It seems so.”_

Wolfe served in the Pentagon and State Department under President Trump, and is an American First patriot. As Wolfe mentions in his piece, we must change course immediately and put American interests first, as “ _Nuclear brinksmanship over Ukraine puts America last._ ”

**Our foreign policy should prioritize American interests, not risk nuclear Armageddon.** It’s high time the “adults in the room” that allegedly run the Biden administration act to defuse this conflict before it’s too late.
|
---
| **Action Alert: We’re Declaring “War on Cartels”**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ecc17c16bc&e=17913c7d6d)
---
The Mexican drug cartels are exploiting Biden’s open border policies to their advantage. These cartels poison America by pushing fentanyl into our country and killing our citizens. That’s why it’s time to take the gloves off and **_declare war on the cartels_**.

A recent writeup in Axios [reveals the details of our new policy paper](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=abaa20ae5b&e=17913c7d6d) which calls for the full force of the government to go after the cartels. Our plan calls for coordination between the American military and Mexican officials, shutting down ports of entry, using the military to target cartel assets, and having the treasury sanction cartel members.

This plan falls in line with our previous calls to declare an invasion to end the border crisis. It’s time our elected officials got serious about what’s really going on at the border, and make the bold moves needed to stop it.
| **We’re Not Stopping: How You Can Join the Fight**
---
| **The stakes have _never been higher_**.

Our countrymen are being targeted by our own government. Our borders are under siege from an invasion and are being exploited by violent drug cartels. Our world is closer to nuclear war than it’s been in decades due to our misguided America last policy with Russia.

We can build an America First movement that stops the deep state, fixes our foreign policy, and crushes the cartels. But we _can’t_ do it without **[your support](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=30950bd926&e=17913c7d6d)**.

Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

Here’s a few of the Warren Democrats I’m proud to be supporting this November — who are campaigning and fighting with everything they’ve got right now:
**Michelle Vallejo** is a daughter of immigrants, fierce community advocate, and small business owner running for a swing U.S. House seat in Texas. She’s fighting for good-paying jobs, quality affordable health care, and a future for all of our kids.
**Greg Casar** is a former labor organizer who pulled off a big primary win for a U.S. House seat in Texas earlier this year. In Washington, he’ll fight to make sure our government works for working people, not corporate interests.
**Summer Lee** is a champion for racial, economic, and environmental justice for all Pennsylvanians. She overcame big money to win her primary for Pennsylvania's 12th U.S. House district, and she’ll make us proud as a congresswoman.
**Mandela Barnes** can flip a GOP Senate seat in Wisconsin to expand our Democratic majority, and he’ll vote to end the filibuster so we can ensure abortion rights across the country. I’m looking forward to heading to Wisconsin later this month to get out the vote.
**Stacey Abrams** has never stopped fighting for the people of Georgia, and she has a plan to make sure everyone in the state can thrive, no matter their ZIP code. She’ll be a governor who lifts up voices that usually aren’t heard in the halls of power.
**Jamie McLeod-Skinner** pulled off an upset primary victory to win the Democratic nomination for a competitive U.S. House seat. In Washington, she’ll fight for lower prescription drug prices, climate action, and policies that put working people first.
**Nikki Budzinski** is a workers’ rights champion running to flip a GOP-held House seat. She’ll bring union experience to Congress, she’ll fight to finally raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour, and she’ll help protect and expand our Democratic majority.
We make real change by coming together and supporting Democrats up and down the ballot who will fight to put power in the hands of working people — where it belongs. That’s why I’m in this fight all the way, and why I’m working to help these candidates get elected this year.

clean_body: You make it possible to support champions like these across the country. | | | I want to share a few of the Warren Democrats I endorsed ahead of their primaries this year who will be on the ballot in November — candidates who know how to fight, know how to win, and know how to tackle the challenges their communities face. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Here’s a few of the Warren Democrats I’m proud to be supporting this November — who are campaigning and fighting with everything they’ve got right now: Michelle Vallejo is a daughter of immigrants, fierce community advocate, and small business owner running for a swing U.S. House seat in Texas. She’s fighting for good-paying jobs, quality affordable health care, and a future for all of our kids. Greg Casar is a former labor organizer who pulled off a big primary win for a U.S. House seat in Texas earlier this year. In Washington, he’ll fight to make sure our government works for working people, not corporate interests. Summer Lee is a champion for racial, economic, and environmental justice for all Pennsylvanians. She overcame big money to win her primary for Pennsylvania's 12th U.S. House district, and she’ll make us proud as a congresswoman. Mandela Barnes can flip a GOP Senate seat in Wisconsin to expand our Democratic majority, and he’ll vote to end the filibuster so we can ensure abortion rights across the country. I’m looking forward to heading to Wisconsin later this month to get out the vote. Stacey Abrams has never stopped fighting for the people of Georgia, and she has a plan to make sure everyone in the state can thrive, no matter their ZIP code. She’ll be a governor who lifts up voices that usually aren’t heard in the halls of power. Jamie McLeod-Skinner pulled off an upset primary victory to win the Democratic nomination for a competitive U.S. House seat. In Washington, she’ll fight for lower prescription drug prices, climate action, and policies that put working people first. Nikki Budzinski is a workers’ rights champion running to flip a GOP-held House seat. She’ll bring union experience to Congress, she’ll fight to finally raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour, and she’ll help protect and expand our Democratic majority. We make real change by coming together and supporting Democrats up and down the ballot who will fight to put power in the hands of working people — where it belongs. That’s why I’m in this fight all the way, and why I’m working to help these candidates get elected this year. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

clean_body: | | | Team Ruiz hopes that you and your family are safe and healthy. Public health across the country is our top concern during this unprecedented time. To view the most up to date CDC COVID-19 safety recommendations, And if you have a moment, please read our message below. I feel really good about where we are in this campaign. At 100,000 people and growing, we’ve got the biggest volunteer organizing team in the country right now. And these volunteers are already at the doors of Texas voters, building relationships and connecting with those who will decide the outcome of this election. Our digital team is leveraging our social media presence to reach voters — especially young voters — with the messages that give them a reason to care about and vote in this election. It’s also been a powerful recruitment tool to bring in new volunteers. And Abbott continues to make the case for why he can’t be trusted with another term in office. Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers, six major mass shootings on his watch, or the outright banning of reproductive health care freedom in Texas, he’s given Texas voters — Republicans as well as Democrats — plenty of reasons to vote for change. The polls are starting to show it as well. A new one has us within just four points — and within the margin of error — of Abbott. While we’ve kept pace with Abbott on a day to day basis, matching his corporate donors with grassroots support, we started this race more than $50 million behind. I really need us to redouble our commitment to meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to have the resources to win. | | | | | | | Thank you, Beto | PO Box 1566 Indio, CA 92202 PAID FOR BY DR. I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, **but we have a problem:** With experts at _FiveThirtyEight_ saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me.

**That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.**

We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign, Peter. And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy.

**Unlike Walker, I refuse to take a cent from corporate PACs. From the very start, I’ve relied entirely on grassroots folks like you to power us to victory – so I have to urgently ask you in this important moment:** [Before the midnight deadline, will you split a donation between The Collective PAC and me to help hit our fundraising goal, win in Georgia, and keep the Senate blue?](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xKUTo15zPnZULmtBaCWrytWRTS36TzAYrpCIVtVmVgPAbvweLCfmJivZurYlNUq25kBoY6FtIAQCh0v2MzKLi7W70I9HHYJeRfMv3TwCfm2uXgcrhFWtHdLUvsyXdvCnX0IM9GsUq8xg5i6z05i5fBsSxm-zy0fmXJKYPHrtl-bSnzUD1aEp1sZygSyTV6mm7OcXY9IjqH7LGb910aboy3_eMaBpc8U0VxE14kFrlaePZQRLwq_J2yb3yQaGki7K5vBriHYXo_5FId5EmCrDxeca0YCzujTEF7_3mWxTYBrVIzqkrU7xQb7PbzDCp2vyQQSVIOE7e1rqs-VNwgZpHvMyxRIwCqA4q9CMkL9JEakw/3qg/W4JzYcKgRkuM5w86GxkxVg/h2/EehqjzrsH6EyQ_ndUJflD6DE4lqTX6zBy3xjBRfYsqc) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately and split between Raphael Warnock and The Collective PAC.

body:
I am reaching out to tell you about one of the closest, most important legislative races in the state. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/23f293f33bd0/a-message-from-treasurer-tobias-read?e=7da9ce3b1a)
---
Hi Friends,With only 19 days until ballots need to be returned, I am reaching out to tell you about one of the **closest, most important legislative races in the state.** Two candidates – who could not be more different – are running to represent parts of Bend, Redmond, Sisters and Tumalo.**Emerson Levy** is the Democratic and Independent nominee, and I endorsed her early because I know Central Oregon deserves a representative who will fight for their values and their future. [**Central Oregon needs and deserves Emerson Levy.**](https://emersonvotes.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65fe8a5975cbf7825219a84b1&id=cb6f35830d&e=7da9ce3b1a) As a mom, Central Oregon’s future is personal to her. As a renewable energy attorney, she has what it takes to turn central Oregon into a leader in clean energy jobs and infrastructure. As a school safety advocate, she has legislation ready to implement much-needed school safety infrastructure. Most essentially, Emerson has the vision for the future, and the skills to meet our current challenges.**And there’s a lot at stake in this race.** Emerson’s opponent is anti-choice, and opposes laws meant to protect LGBTQ Oregonians. He cheered on the Jan. 6th insurrection and denied the results of the 2020 presidential election. He plans to gut public education funding and slow down climate action. **And his campaign is well-funded.** In the waning days of this race it is critical that voters know Emerson. Another mail piece will get her message out to thousands more voters, and she needs to raise $15,000 this week to fund it. [**Will you join me in investing in Emerson and the future of Central Oregon by donating $100, $250, $500 or whatever is significant to you today?**](https://emersonvotes.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65fe8a5975cbf7825219a84b1&id=6b27d21f76&e=7da9ce3b1a)
| [Donate Here](https://emersonvotes.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65fe8a5975cbf7825219a84b1&id=5be6984ca1&e=7da9ce3b1a)
---
**When you join me in supporting Emerson’s campaign,** you can**help me protect a woman’s right to choose, protect our natural resources, protect our public schools, protect our democracy, and protect our future.** As State Treasurer I know how to spot a good investment. I’m here to tell you Emerson is one. Let’s get her elected.-Treasurer Tobias Read
| [Donate Here](https://emersonvotes.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65fe8a5975cbf7825219a84b1&id=876d68501d&e=7da9ce3b1a)

| Peter,
I recently joined Tucker Carlson and the buzz around my campaign has continued to gain tremendous momentum. I’m taking time from my busy schedule campaigning to write you this email, so even if you don’t send a gift, I’d really appreciate it if you’d read it in its entirety.
**[If you’d like to make a donation to continue my campaign’s momentum, you can do so here.](http://email.email.socialism-watch.com/c/eJxdkVtvpSAUhX-Nvmlwe3_woa1pk8nMnJyHSftG6AaVlotBrDn_ftDYNmlCIKwFe3-wRJdVVQUtFFkZ8y6vSyyGOpYdEICMAMlaQgik1YBZmxdlgY3AXGBUEKGZVOliUTIlF51szOOUotXx1OWvvC0ZwwY4IoGsGHjNmiZrigIyTrJYdZP38xLldxE8hrEIXJ1IN2mc4HuRoA1OCsOXxA4Jt-uYaLZ4J5mxweOacmuo1XTZqFCY-BXf6aujn9xR_si0XY2P8h7KCCq3d3DSjEHwbhVBWr2mWnC56qAdzznFxa4ORRANKsr0rORwOy0MWyZHs5c9Gn1j7UTMyx1L3fQsca_N6MacswFUKIGHu6MKF2BtWNgovpjpaO2oPsnQGi8O_kCRvJvmWv69frw9B5saJXkwfoiT5OFH-5fLbTI9-R27js-bVCGdqg6BjUdge0Dnk7qovo8AjmsARxZQDU-u_2if23_J9dcl-cNeLs1uwkOY_W0WXyfPIun5cRDV_X_RjsBI)**
We covered a number of topics that I think every voter in PA should know about.
**The Establishment turning their back on a 30 year Army veteran.** I served our country honorably and led some of the best young men our nation has to offer, yet when I announced for Governor the political Establishment on both sides shunned me... it must mean I’m speaking the hard truths, but as our second President John Adams famously said “facts are stubborn things.” The political Establishment in our country is failing Republicans, Democrats, and everyone in between, and I’ll never bow to their go-along get-along agenda. They doubted me in the primary, but with the backing of the grassroots and patriots in Pennsylvania and across our country, I proved them wrong, and I’m going to do it again on November 8th.
**Unleashing Pennsylvania’s oil and gas reserves to jumpstart our economy on Day 1 of a Mastriano administration.** The answer to many of our economic woes is unleashing American energy dominance, and as Governor of Pennsylvania, on Day 1, I’ll have the power to open up drilling and fracking at a scale never seen before in our nation’s history. Joe Biden’s war on American energy got us into this mess, and Pennsylvania will be where the American energy comeback begins. | | | | [DONATE](http://email.email.socialism-watch.com/c/eJxdkU9vpSAUxT-N7jSIgrpw0da0yaTNyywm83YE4apk-GMQa963HzS2k0xCIJwD9_7gQFdQSnGLq4KksitrIqqxTlWHEcYFwqhoEUI4p6Mo2rIilWhAlCCSCoHhSuerE4prtZps50HMuXAmnbu6IBVCLRkJUEoaGIaKFHwYiqYh49A2qe7mEJY1KZ8S_BrHCmLzkO_KepBHkaiNXoGVa-bGTLptygxfg1fcuuhJw6SzzBm27gy0yMIm_rDBsy_upHzlxm02JGWPSYKpPzp4ZacoBL9BlLZgmAGpNhO18zmXuLrNC4iiFZpxs2g1Pi5LxC1Xkz3Kno3-YR1EPKgDSz_MosRRm7Ode-8iKGgQp3uggo-wLi58gm9mNjk36S8y4WyAkz9SZMNdrM9P9APeos2sVjIa_4mzkvFH-_vtMdsevae-k8uudEyH1jGw6QzsCOh6UpfUzwnG5zWMzywwHd98_9n-bn9lP3_csg9-vzWHiV_iHB4LfJ-8iuTXx-Gk7v8CEcy_rw)
---
**Josh Shapiro’s record of failure when it comes to violent crime.**
Unlike Josh Shapiro, I’ve served in war zones, and right now Philadelphia looks more like a war zone than the city where American Democracy was born. Crime has gone up 40% since Shapiro took power as Attorney General. Videos have surfaced online showing bands of criminals with illegal automatic weapons hopping out of vans at gas stations in Philadelphia and stealing cars of innocent citizens. There’s one place criminals like that will be under a Mastriano Administration, the state penitentiary, where they will be serving maximum sentences.

**There are 12 Pennsylvanian’s dying everyday from Fentynal.**
Biden’s open border has drugs flowing into our country freely and it’s causing a drug epidemic in Pennsylvania. Dealers and traffickers of these lethal drugs will be in the same place as the criminals sticking up drivers at gunpoint, the penitentiary.

At the end of our interview, Tucker came to the same conclusion that everyone who knows me can testify to, I’m not a radical, I’m just a guy who loves his country and his state too much to let it be destroyed by the woke left. I could have ridden off into the sunset for a comfortable retirement with the love of my life, my wife Rebbie, but instead I’m here, fighting for you and your family. **[I’d be proud to call you a donor to my campaign if you’re in a position to give.](http://email.email.socialism-watch.com/c/eJxdkUur3SAUhX9NMktIdt6DDNqGWygthw7a3pl4dCeR-ghqTjj99dWQewsFUVxL9_504Vi2bQsD1GWT8rHqGlbPXSpGKADKAopyKIoC8nZm5VDVTc16ZBWypC5QUSFzZ5igUjiVHdSzNWdGpevYQ99WM-3v7N5Cye9YlUNT03KosacDFKkcV-83l1QfEngJwyHbLeaH0BZ5LBK02QrU3GVmzrjZl0xR562g2gSPK8KNJkYRdxCULPM7-03ulrxxJ9ULVWbXPqkmaBJobexghV6C4O2OQdq9Igq52FXQzudcojO7ZRhEzSShapNifl4WC1sqFh3Lno3-YUUi6kXEkk-1CRZrU3JQa00ARYnsdCMq2gBrwkIXfGcmizGLfCNjRns8-QNF9picfvyc6J8j2ERLwYPxn7gKHn50er09Vz0VX1M78u0QMqTTdiGw5QwsBnQ9aUy6jwnAeQ3gzALa-bOdHsOv4Uf2_cst-0Zfb3004VOY_XPD95NXkfz6OEi66S84gsFJ)**

After 30 years in uniform serving our country, I know one thing, the fight to save our country is worth fighting. Nothing on earth has ever come close to the greatness of the promise of the American Dream, and I’m doing everything in my power to preserve it. I’d be honored if you joined me.

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: The stakes:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=SIAgc3MSSTmMadv8aigICvR8M50Oe7ht&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
With only 18 days between now and Election Day, I need to be upfront about what's at stake:
**If we lose this seat, it won 't just mean that another Trump-backed extremist - my opponent - is in the Senate. It will also mean that Mitch McConnell has retaken control of the chamber - and that he'll have a radical new colleague to rubber-stamp his disastrous GOP agenda.**

Right now, we have the slimmest possible 50/50 majority in the Senate. Women's rights, access to the ballot box, and our democracy itself are on the line in Arkansas's Senate race, but new polling shows Natalie 3 point(s) behind her GOP opponent. It's going to take all of us to help Natalie overcome a million dollar war chest and keep the Senate blue. There's a real fight happening in our country between extremists taking us backward and folks like us fighting for progress. And Arkansas's Senate race is the epicenter of that fight. **Natalie will be the first African-American woman elected to U.S. Senate from Arkansas. She grew up in a working-class family like me. My dad was a door-to-door salesman worker, Natalie 's dad got his start as an insurance broker. My mom was a cafeteria worker, Natalie's was a teacher.** If Natalie loses this race, the forces of fear and extremism win. They take control of the Senate. Peter, alongside our parent organization, the Collective Education Fund, Vote To Live works every day to get one message across to Black voters: **your future is on the ballot, and your vote has the power to shape it.**

That’s not a hypothetical. Time and again, we’ve seen the difference Black voters make when we show up and exercise our right to shape our country and our future. And two years ago, the Collective network played a key role to make that happen. [Our network provided more than 70,000 free rides to the polls for Black voters in Georgia’s runoff elections — ultimately helping make history by electing the first-ever Black Democratic Senator from the South.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yIEH_ir9hU9NCRfoHIq0PI3GN8l2slhja47nJNc6GqHqV1oUvH67PEpicWr56I7i0pX-kOzA1kazX552mZACxB-_n_SULSwByJEfQIVgHfGDlbGy5n_JkbPT2PXkXWcT2wC5lGJb81m5725gIWSpcEW-xUUpzNC6e9tSwPgXqjw53SqKRZHVNKabVZe7n2s6eWp1NZCcw-AeWBt3Hoz6-En8vDh26Cuzu_fXjHgZgvDZAjAKhboDm8PNSRM6wIbbKmvnabBXG1CV_QwTCDnvlZIAWqcH8F1h7pETtA-8vpc2dmOHHrXcaTSJ0IblYDog34BMfyhmE1t-jOmSOiI6d4CtG2F9ffftLR3EQ87wjlGnnn5BWhyKGQEnR7rcHUMOIcdUJBP5xXq18wnMv2OWdQ/3qg/IS-48YpCSQGh-BQ2ja1PPQ/h8/Bn5zIgNv8Lu6_-pewKKjrb5qwE5HqKvnLa8OLqusCmE)

If that’s not power, we don’t know what is. And this year, Vote To Live aims to do it again — at a much larger scale. We’re working to replicate our success all around the country — and thanks in part to our partnership with the folks at Crooked Media and Pod Save America, we’re already making serious strides. Whether it’s engaging voters, getting folks registered, or helping voters actually make it to the polls, right now, we have the potential to dramatically shape our future for the better, for Black communities and our entire country.

Justice and safety. Access to good jobs, good housing, quality healthcare, and real opportunity for our kids. Fundamental freedoms, including the freedom to vote. **These issues directly affect the lives of Black Americans, and every Black voter should be able to get to the ballot box and choose leaders who will stand with our communities — every single day.**

Throughout Early Voting and all the way to November 8th, we’re pushing to provide a free ride to the polls to every Black voter who needs one — a key, concrete piece of the puzzle to lower the barriers and ensure every Black voter can make their voice heard. body:
---
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52980284/374066103/-713949207?refcode=EM_BS_JAS_221020_FR_Faith_A0_na_U2_X2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODg4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzFjNThjOS1iMTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yG862kc2fgXaW5OeHAQjgx_yXShl4Vi3He_jAkhK8G8=) My faith is what keeps me going. That and how fired up people in Western NC are right now. (Also caffeine – coffee and Mountain Dew Zero to get specific about it.) My faith is a source of hope, perspective, and incredibly clear instructions – treat others with love, hope, and empathy. But unlike my radical opponent who said “Christian conservatives are on the cusp of taking back our country,” I don’t believe in imposing my faith on others or weaponizing it to strip away our basic freedoms. **Let me be clear: I’m pro-choice, I believe in the freedom to love who you love, and when I get to Congress, I’ll fight to protect our rights.** Right now, I’m within a single-digit margin of my extremist Republican opponent. Even though his values don’t align with the majority of WNC’s, he’s got millions of dollars behind him to reach voters with his toxic brand of politics. This race is winnable and you can feel the momentum growing. We felt it yesterday in Polk, Henderson, and Buncombe Counties as we were out knocking doors, and then at a rally in Brevard. Fellow Conservative,

It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and **kill more than 500 passengers.**

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

**[In just a moment, I am going to ask you to donate $3 to my campaign for Congress, in honor of the seventh anniversary of the Thalys train attack.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=0c8228c01b7c401fb6d664248c6528c0&_e=-jJZqhRLpK8IWExG02sRS9F-jRRaqsfSWYZPZBESKKqDoPW1AePTQU8zcGt9yd5qxd4e0oubAURqNIxV2GPuM2PMu-CNXZJGcXkNFNpa1HVq4NRr54_eIa0A8vfVeO2VvJMVCi0UyntdP0hTmoIeaHd9qYCu9U8GzLtsLdLvIXTcCaLolcAymKBGDblx-IVTk0y2RBUMLiMQm8vhWT1pFhxwAziPEs0zDq_FlQRHEKe_IgTQSrTVNz214YLhYLCW3V9nPbrtKr3qmBNH7g4wpMDGWEZT4NfGVtkSSM6dJhCQoderi7-LW4Ju-J3wmpt-3_5zbBSX3kzWDSJxQX6fqAg-9wV0iQxNFcfJ-KHPNrubZIyfkQNfUF84OwQNU5TaIN3r_TJxZQbKSRfEpbakG0Cfso5u0AxgrwXIjSzdLL8%3D)** But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington.

**If I can't tell this story to voters in my district, I'm going to lose my race.** I know by now that you've seen this email time and again, but the truth of the matter is that I don't seem to be able to get the attention of donors we need to win any other way. **So, with just 20 days left until Election Day, we wanted to reach out once more to see if we could[ win your support.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=0c8228c01b7c401fb6d664248c6528c0&_e=-jJZqhRLpK8IWExG02sRS9F-jRRaqsfSWYZPZBESKKqDoPW1AePTQU8zcGt9yd5qxd4e0oubAURqNIxV2GPuM2PMu-CNXZJGcXkNFNpa1HVq4NRr54_eIa0A8vfVeO2VvJMVCi0UyntdP0hTmoIeaHd9qYCu9U8GzLtsLdLvIXTcCaLolcAymKBGDblx-IVTk0y2RBUMLiMQm8vhWT1pFhxwAziPEs0zDq_FlQRHEKe_IgTQSrTVNz214YLhYLCW-R63U6KDH_md2FNzon3wC_zGHQcbjYF51L9PA-0MxLulxg_IND-JVGZyoWeydlSMfBW_QNJw1NGcrqGb3i51nT8GqXUXgDsZMjOwn_1jQ-w7nKlpL31nannKm88QOuAcwW-N3pxvDv0-64ZtM1qtPXA6XNulZ5X3CgAFYZPcu7c%3D)**

**Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation.** Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream.

Right now, Democrats are...
* Opening and destroying our borders. They are granting dangerous amnesty that have and will continue to flood every corner of America.
* Raising our taxes like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable.
* Indoctrinating the American people with their woke, Leftist ideology.
* Teetering on the edge of dangerous foreign policy crises.

These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. **They only care about their own radical agenda, and my opponent, Val Hoyle will be another one of their foot soldiers.**

Friends –
Just a couple of months ago I did something I’d never done before: I wrote to you on behalf of Maggie Hassan with a specific ask. [**I asked you to chip in to her campaign and join me in supporting the Senator’s fight for reelection.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52980553/374066898/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1890-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzFjNThjOS1iMTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QEvTiUDmio7xe7c2KJj6n16ISuGMoB6mfqpFe-3LKMM=)
I reached out because with the Senate split 50-50, the GOP only needs to flip one seat to regain control of the chamber and return Mitch McConnell to the Majority Leader’s office. And they are all in on flipping this seat, which Maggie Hassan won by just 1,017 votes.
When I first reached out it was already clear that Maggie was going to need all hands on deck to win a decisive race in an incredibly purple state.
But since then, I’ve watched as the GOP has flooded the Granite State with tens of millions of dollars in smears against Maggie; I watched as Republicans selected Don Bolduc, the most extreme candidate in modern New Hampshire history to run against her; and I watched as her opponent proved time and time again that he is dangerously wrong for New Hampshire and this country. **[We’ve got to make sure we help Maggie beat this guy.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52980555/374066901/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1890-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzFjNThjOS1iMTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QEvTiUDmio7xe7c2KJj6n16ISuGMoB6mfqpFe-3LKMM=)**
One of his most recent statements had my jaw on the floor. He said, point blank, that “as a man,” he believes women’s most personal decisions about abortion **“belong” to Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.**
Yeah, you read that right.
This is just the latest in a long line of extreme anti-choice positions from Bolduc: he said he would never vote against pro-life legislation and when asked about the threat of a nationwide abortion ban he told women to “**get over it.** ”
We need to pull together to make sure this guy never gets the power to actually make these decisions for women. And that means putting everything we’ve got behind Maggie.
**[We still have time to make a real difference in this race but only if we act decisively and immediately.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52980557/374066902/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1890-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzFjNThjOS1iMTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QEvTiUDmio7xe7c2KJj6n16ISuGMoB6mfqpFe-3LKMM=)**

| | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. **[With $31 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win in November.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7609369e-7cb5-4eda-bac7-71400b32f097/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** So I’m asking:

body:
Rep. Stansbury’s race is tight & we need all hands on deck
#
Peter,
We all know we need to defend the House majority – but let’s be honest, some races are tighter than others. My friend and colleague Rep. Melanie Stansbury is in one of those tight races for re-election in New Mexico.
In just under a week, I’ll be at Melanie’s side campaigning in her district, because I know we need her leadership in Congress. I know I don’t need to explain to you why we need to hold our Democratic majority.
**But what if I told you we could protect a critical blue seat AND support a committed progressive who’s shown she will always fight for the people?**
[**Just 19 days out from the midterm elections, this is a critical time for competitive races. I’m hoping you’ll join me & support Melanie today – will you make a difference in her race with a $5 donation?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20224?refcode=em20221020-1739&t=1&akid=1739%2E420207%2Ehlod8c)
**[Contribute $5 →](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20224?refcode=em20221020-1739&t=2&akid=1739%2E420207%2Ehlod8c)**
There are three very important reasons why I’m supporting Rep. Stansbury, and you should too:
* **Melanie is a proven progressive champion** and former scientist who will continue to defend reproductive rights, support Medicare for All, and fight for climate and environmental justice.
* **Melanie’s opponent is a cookie-cutter MAGA Republican** who will advance the GOP’s extreme anti-abortion agenda and prioritize loyalty to Trump.
* As a freshman in the House, **Republicans see Melanie as particularly vulnerable** , and they’ve identified her seat as a **top target** in the midterms.

[**Melanie is running out of time to raise the resources she’ll need to win over her MAGA opponent. It’s all hands on deck right now – so can we count on your contribution today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/20224?refcode=em20221020-1739&t=3&akid=1739%2E420207%2Ehlod8c)
In solidarity,
Pramila

subject: Some good and bad news about where we stand
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
We don’t like to share bad news, but we needed to let you know this:
#

We hate to share bad news with you, but we need to let you know where we stand as of this afternoon.
National Republicans are continuing to drastically outspend us. They have poured millions of dollars into this race because they know Cheri has what it takes to win. And despite that, we are still TIED with our Trump-backed opponent.
While we don’t need to match GOP spending dollar for dollar, we do need to keep up our momentum and meet our fundraising goals to keep our momentum. And as of right now, we’re still trying to close a budget gap so we can make the investments necessary during early voting.
We don’t say this to alarm you, because there’s good news too: We have the toughest people-powered campaign North Carolina has ever seen. This team is filled with people like you who are fired up and deeply invested in electing Cheri Beasley. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
I will continue to advocate for the LGBTQ+ community and fight for equality as Governor — just like I have for my entire career.

I hope you'll read this entire email, but if you don't, this is the big thing you need to know:
**A number of Republicans have pledged that — if they win the majority in the House and Senate next month — they will work to sunset all federal programs, including Social Security and Medicare. While some have discounted this risk, we know that cutting these health and retirement programs will come into play as Republicans are already threatening to hold next year’s debt ceiling deadline hostage to their whims.**
[**We still have 19 days to stop them and their reckless plans, and we need to make every day count! Can you chip in $3, or whatever you are able, to support our final push to protect our Democratic majority and support Democratic candidates in tough races across the country?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52983570/374077861/2039821469?refcode=&refcode2=6c331409-b950-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=3ejGBPFW+jxWlNdQ1sVE9wwdz+jACb5sbHK0yjWR0MkqIM9rml0BKHdAi0GmiUOT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzMzMTQwOS1iOTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k_rgeUJrZrSRxaAzb7oL4hntU-Mp37OZrTE7GosLd9o=)
****[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52983573/374077862/2039821469?refcode=&refcode2=6c331409-b950-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=3ejGBPFW+jxWlNdQ1sVE9wwdz+jACb5sbHK0yjWR0MkqIM9rml0BKHdAi0GmiUOT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzMzMTQwOS1iOTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k_rgeUJrZrSRxaAzb7oL4hntU-Mp37OZrTE7GosLd9o=)****
A number of Senate Republicans have put forward new plans to sunset or cut Social Security and Medicare — and leave the folks who paid into those programs without the support they were told they could rely on. That's unacceptable.
Florida Senator Rick Scott wants to put our historic social insurance programs up for Congressional reauthorization every five years — a formula that would ensure a GOP rush to put them on the chopping block. Not to be outdone, Wisconsin Senator Ron Johnson wants Congress to vote annually on whether seniors will continue to receive the retirement support that they have already paid into — and rely on to access prescription drugs.
The House Republican Leader, Kevin McCarthy, has already signaled that if Republicans win the majority, next year’s debt-ceiling deadline will be used to make large cuts to programs — and that means they will target programs that are essential to seniors and families. We have seen this movie before and they haven’t changed their stripes.
[**That's why it’s so critically important that we keep working every single day to get folks to the polls to protect our Democratic majorities. The stakes are too high to leave anything on the table.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52983577/374077868/2039821469?refcode=&refcode2=6c331409-b950-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=3ejGBPFW+jxWlNdQ1sVE9wwdz+jACb5sbHK0yjWR0MkqIM9rml0BKHdAi0GmiUOT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YzMzMTQwOS1iOTUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k_rgeUJrZrSRxaAzb7oL4hntU-Mp37OZrTE7GosLd9o=)
In 2010 when the 'Tea Party' Republicans won the majority in the House of Representatives, I became the Ranking Democrat on the Budget Committee. In that role, I spent my days and evenings battling Paul Ryan and the “trickle down” ideologues to prevent massive cuts to our social safety net. That same ideology still has a tight grip on the GOP. And — if they get control of the reins of Congress — the wealthiest Americans will be just fine, but seniors, families, and others will suffer.
This fight is about what kind of country we want to be.
Thank you for being a part of this.
Onwards!
Chris

Friends – I write to you today, not as an actor or a former (fictional) president, but as an American concerned about losing our Democratic Senate majority: **Donald Trump just left Nevada where he held a MAGA rally to defeat Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control.**
If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R)– if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats will lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell will regain his iron grip on power.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: I need Summer with me in Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
I know exactly what Summer is going through.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221020-3513-header&t=1&akid=3513%2E2526796%2EckW5Nw)
Hi there,
**I’m reaching out today because an alarming amount of money is being spent by the Congressional Leadership Fund — a major GOP super PAC — attacking Summer Lee and her campaign.**
Summer Lee is a Pennsylvania state legislator born and raised in the Mon Valley, in the heart of Pennsylvania’s 12th District, where she’s running. And, she would be the first Black woman to represent Pennsylvania in Congress.
Growing up in North Braddock, the air was thick with pollution from the Mon Valley steel mills. Summer and her neighbors have seen firsthand how corporations will choose their own wealth over our health, and put profits over people — forcing communities like hers to rely on jobs that make them sick, while making them believe they had no other choice.
Summer is running for Congress because all her life she has seen how communities like hers are left behind. Summer knows we need elected officials who don’t just talk the talk. We need ones who’ll fight the fight with the urgency our crises demand — for environmental justice, union jobs, and racial equity.
That is why Summer Lee prioritizes key pieces of legislation such as a Green New Deal, a living wage, Medicare for All, abortion access, and justice reform.
But, once again super PACs are using dirty political tactics to undermine Summer’s campaign, by spending millions to stop progress and bold change from having a seat in Congress. [That’s why I’m personally coming to you today to ask if you can chip in whatever you can to ensure Summer has the resources needed to fight back against these attacks. Can we count on your donation now?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221020.cBIbK_&refcode=em20221020-3513-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3513%2E2526796%2EckW5Nw)
**[Chip in $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221020.cBIbK_&refcode=em20221020-3513-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3513%2E2526796%2EckW5Nw)**
I am no stranger to attack ads, blatant disinformation from extremist publications, or racist and misogynistic attacks on me and my character. But regardless, I have always been determined to run my campaign the right way, _and that’s what I see from Summer Lee._
Summer has delivered unapologetic, bold leadership, and is unafraid to stand up to status-quo politicians and push for policies that will lift up working families and her community. Her record speaks for itself and the truth of the matter is this:
_**The GOP is afraid of Summer and this progressive movement.**_
That is why they are spending so much to try and keep a true champion for working people from winning on November 8**.** Summer prioritizes integrity, transparency, and accountability, and doesn’t take a cent from corporate donors or super PAC’s, that’s why we need to have her back now. [ If you can afford it, please make your contribution right now to help Summer fight back against GOP disinformation and win her election in 19 days.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221020.cBIbK_&refcode=em20221020-3513-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3513%2E2526796%2EckW5Nw)
**I can’t wait to work alongside Summer in Congress. I know that, together, we’ll accomplish great things.**
P’alante!
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20221020?refcode=em20221020-3513-P_FND_ANO_END&t=23&refcode2=3513_2526796_ckW5Nw&akid=3513%2E2526796%2EckW5Nw)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20221020-3513-P_FND_ANO_END&t=24&akid=3513%2E2526796%2EckW5Nw)**

Hello Peter Hopefully, you got to see my debate from Tuesday night. If not, [here’s a link to watch the replay](https://votereedolson.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=aae982862c&e=0ba866af2d). The good news is my opponent actually showed up to the debate. **The bad news is my opponent failed to discuss constructive solutions to issues facing us** _**now**_. It is because he has none. Instead, he veered off into national politics from 2016 and brought up an irrelevant point about Hillary Clinton as if merely invoking her name would summon voters to the polls. Regardless, the job of Representative has a fairly straightforward promise in the job title. You expect to be “represented,” right? My opponent has consistently ignored the issues facing our district. He had a chance to defend his record. He failed. He had a chance to illustrate for us policies he supported that actually made a difference in our community. He failed. He had a chance to represent us for six years. **He failed the most basic principle of the job – to represent us.** Unlike my opponent, I will not ignore the housing crisis, the lack of daycare, the scarcity of mental health resources, or the crushing poverty gripping our region.**I will represent all of us when you give me the chance.**[See for yourself.](https://votereedolson.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=2f34cfbb04&e=0ba866af2d) You can use these timestamps to skip to the parts of the debate you want to watch.1:51 - opening comments (Opposition)
4:49 - opening comments (Reed)
8:04 - education funding
13:48 - abortion
18:47 - opioid crisis
24:10 - tax relief
29:52 - election system
34:29 - housing shortage
41:14 - gun violence
46:45 - relations with tribal nations
50:28 - closing comments (Reed)
52:55 - closing comments (Opposition)As you can see in this debate, my opponent panders to his base with tired RNC talking points instead of offering real solutions to issues facing our district. Please [**donate**](https://votereedolson.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=f0344572ab&e=0ba866af2d)**** what you can because time is running out to buy meaningful media to defend myself from the juggernaut of dark money fueled political action committees doing my opponent’s dirty work. Thank you for your continued support!
-Reed Olson

body:
The truth is that we cannot do it without you
#

Friends,
We won’t mince words here: our rights and freedoms are at stake in this election. Our democracy is at stake.
If we lose our democratic majorities in the House and Senate, Republicans will _immediately_ start implementing a right-wing extremist agenda.
We’re talking about a national abortion ban.
We’re talking about attacks on our immigrant communities.
We’re talking about attacks on LGBTQ communities.
We’re talking about an environmental policy that leaves California unprepared for the devastating impacts of climate change.
We’re talking about tax breaks for big corporations and the ultra-wealthy.
We’re even talking about attacks on our free and fair elections — the _cornerstone_ of our democracy.
Alex is working hard — getting out the vote in tough House races here in California and competitive Senate races across the country — but the truth is that we cannot do it without you.
The ONLY way we’re going to be able to ensure we hold our majorities and keep making progress for California and the country is if lots and lots of folks like you get involved.

I speak to you today as a concerned fellow American
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52987709/374091485/-35107828?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4464-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTVkMWM4ZC1jMjUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tqOf_bsRdtejj2EPKx-MC79H4uRIZoaXmuWlUQBuVes=) Hi friend, I know you've heard from a lot of people about how Catherine Cortez Masto's (D-NV) and Rev. Raphael Warnock's (D-GA) Senate races are the most important in the country – but with just weeks until the election, I wanted you to hear it from me, too. While you might associate me with my roles as an actor – particularly a former (fictional) president – I speak to you today as a concerned fellow American: **If Catherine Cortez Masto and Raphael Warnock lose in Nevada and Georgia, we hand over control of the Senate to Mitch McConnell, and worse still, pave the way for a second Trump era. **
---
[**I am going to do everything in my power to make sure that doesn't happen, which is why I'm emailing. Will you split a donation between Catherine’s campaign and Raphael Warnock’s to keep the Senate blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52987710/374091486/-35107828?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4464-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTVkMWM4ZC1jMjUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tqOf_bsRdtejj2EPKx-MC79H4uRIZoaXmuWlUQBuVes=)
You know as well as I do why we can't let the GOP win. The last time Republicans controlled our democratic institutions – headed by McConnell and the impeached former president – was marked by deception, selfishness, and every hindrance of progress possible. This period culminated in an attack on democracy itself, sanctioned by many of those who could be part of the Senate majority if Sen. Cortez Masto and Sen. Warnock lose their seats.
The darkness of those years should serve as a reminder for why our Democratic majority is so crucial – but the _hopefulness_ of recent days should be our clarion call. Sen. Cortez Masto, Sen. Warnock, and their Democratic colleagues have helmed historic action on infrastructure, climate change, and lowering prescription drug prices. They confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court. And so much more.
**With hope and hard work, we've accomplished a great deal.****But with Sen. Cortez Masto and Sen. Warnock neck and neck in the polls and up against millions in GOP attacks, they need our help to win.**
[**Let's help Sen. Cortez Masto and Sen. Warnock raise $50,000 before their midnight fundraising deadline. Split $5 between her campaign and Raphael’s, or whatever you can spare, to save our Democratic majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52987711/374091487/-35107828?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4464-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTVkMWM4ZC1jMjUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tqOf_bsRdtejj2EPKx-MC79H4uRIZoaXmuWlUQBuVes=)
I've been an activist most of my life, friend. I've witnessed our nation confront and overcome a host of consequential challenges. And I've learned that, at such critical junctures of history, we must ask ourselves: _Who do we want to be as a country?_
Do we want to be a country where the very right to bodily autonomy lies in the hands of right-wing extremists? The kind of country where health care and lifesaving medications are so expensive, they are out of reach for countless Americans? The kind of country where outright lies and conspiracies are used to tear down our democracy?
I say _no_ _._ _No_ to the country that MAGA Republican rule would manifest. No to extremism and attacks on democracy and fundamental rights. **But – and I say this with no exaggeration – this all rides on whether****Catherine Cortez Masto and Raphael Warnock win their battleground Senate races.**
Experts from _The New York Times_ to _CNN_ are reporting Sen. Cortez Masto and Rev. Warnock are the most vulnerable Democratic senators on the ballot, so we urgently need to do our part of help them win. **[Will you please split a donation of $5, or whatever you can spare today, between Catherine’s campaign and Raphael’s to help save our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52987712/374091488/-35107828?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4464-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTVkMWM4ZC1jMjUwLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tqOf_bsRdtejj2EPKx-MC79H4uRIZoaXmuWlUQBuVes=)**
Thank you,
Martin Sheen

body:
Right now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GR |
---
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=83eda8a2d2cc423da6254437fdbe753d&_e=Emg_ebnsCnvRkbBaNeBW_lCjIlakXujZbEOUgWBPLiW1uM2xQrfOduHlguF-3twck0xJhJSFk9h8QDGwlRPBSRogmfvAgMh2hiCza_qMKcQ8UaNr9cilgjYhNKajkZUzgfr9IhCXV4s4eHzMGU8_Yfbrl89UmNCYRZyHJIuALhE_CsvsBzUIl8C6djdnxLLdALtiFggp6p6vVX7bFFZaESsrWUf5fry-1iMpp1Ku3Bz7BA-RDCpNoWXB0nKN99Sq0XXBB-lFs9Qvo6nzI-pMpXzGUW3K8psxIx0TcLLGamenKK_ORzKTU66SMDnlh2yalmHcsnafK5I93Ts0rwm1K3tR528fglGYFgW2IJO6DnD87SAA-YxFAQ1s8gJiHfd4vOIxL8Vd6z9LYFmaagrq45HWbKg72zv76ztpipLZUKo%3D)

Peter,

It was Friday, August 21, 2015. I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and **kill more than 500 passengers.**

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
Hey Derek,
I am reaching out myself before our final end-of-month deadline to ask a favor of you.
My race for U.S. Senate is one of the most competitive races in the entire country. At least three different pollsters in recent weeks have released polls that show our race tied, and CNN says North Carolina is one of the three seats “most likely to flip” to Democrats.
Our campaign is throwing out the old playbook and running the kind of grassroots campaign it takes to win in North Carolina. It’s clear that our strategy is working.
But this is a significant undertaking. It’s not cheap to organize everywhere and make sure voters — from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike — all hear that we understand their hopes and needs.
I’m grateful for this team. The outpouring of support means the world to me. I sincerely mean it, and I hope you know that I do not make these asks lightly.
We cannot slow down or falter now, so please:
I am personally asking you to split a contribution of $25 between my campaign and CommonGood before our final end-of-month deadline. With the race in a dead heat, your donation today could swing this race in our favor on Election Day. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cb?refcode=20221020_CGVA_CB]

**We have a "knife's edge Senate" right now.**
With 50 Democrats and 50 Republicans split evenly down the middle, there’s no margin for error.
Because Democrats won the White House in 2020, Vice President Kamala Harris has served as the tie-breaking vote on the progressive legislation we’ve been able to pass over the last couple of years, like the American Rescue Plan and the Inflation Reduction Act.
Despite our wins, forecasters like _FiveThirtyEight_ are calling the Senate a toss-up for the 2022 midterms. **That means we have just the next 19 days to protect and grow our Democratic majority if we want to keep advancing a progressive agenda**. We must hold as many seats as we can, including Vermont’s, and that means electing Peter Welch.
[**Experts are still calling the Senate a toss-up with not much time until Election Day, so if you’re able, please chip in $5 or anything you can towards Peter’s Senate run right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4697?t=3&akid=1103%2E61531%2EnHgMk3)

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table.
